ACTOR_CHANGED.title: Access changed
ACTOR_CHANGED.when: The caller's access to the organization changed between the request starting and its write.
ACTOR_CHANGED.fix: Check the key's scopes and organization with GET /api/v1/api-keys/me, then send the request again.

ADMITS_TOO_MANY.title: Too many admitted pass types
ADMITS_TOO_MANY.when: The scanner's admits list names more pass types than allowed, counting each event's.
ADMITS_TOO_MANY.fix: Shorten admits so it names fewer pass types, then send the request again.

API_KEY_CHILD_CANNOT_MINT.title: Child key cannot mint keys
API_KEY_CHILD_CANNOT_MINT.when: A key that was itself created by a key tried to create a key.
API_KEY_CHILD_CANNOT_MINT.fix: Create the key with the original parent key or from a signed-in session.

API_KEY_CHILD_WIDER.title: Child key wider than its parent
API_KEY_CHILD_WIDER.when: The new key asks for a scope, mode or restriction broader than its parent key has.
API_KEY_CHILD_WIDER.fix: Request only scopes the parent key already holds, or create the key with a broader parent.

API_KEY_EXPIRY_REQUIRED.title: Expiry required
API_KEY_EXPIRY_REQUIRED.when: A personal key, a platform key, or a key with the scanning:admin scope was made without an expiry.
API_KEY_EXPIRY_REQUIRED.fix: Send expiresAt, at most 90 days ahead.

API_KEY_EXPIRY_TOO_LONG.title: Expiry too far ahead
API_KEY_EXPIRY_TOO_LONG.when: A personal key, a platform key, or a key with the scanning:admin scope has an expiry more than 90 days ahead.

API_KEY_MISSING.title: No API key
API_KEY_MISSING.when: The Authorization header names the Bearer scheme but carries no key.
API_KEY_MISSING.fix: Set PASSBOOK_KEY to your key, export it, and send Authorization: Bearer $PASSBOOK_KEY.

API_KEY_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Key mode mismatch
API_KEY_MODE_MISMATCH.when: You tried to rotate a key from the other mode (live or test).
API_KEY_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Call the rotate endpoint with a key in the same mode as the key you rotate.

API_KEY_NOT_FOUND.title: Key not found
API_KEY_NOT_FOUND.when: No key with this id exists in the current mode and organization.
API_KEY_NOT_FOUND.fix: Look up the id with GET /api/v1/api-keys, using a key of the same mode.

API_KEY_NOT_ROTATABLE.title: Key cannot be rotated
API_KEY_NOT_ROTATABLE.when: The key is already revoked, retiring or expired.
API_KEY_NOT_ROTATABLE.fix: Create a new key with POST /api/v1/api-keys instead of rotating this one.

API_KEY_NO_APPROVAL.title: Key cannot approve
API_KEY_NO_APPROVAL.when: A key tried to approve or override a scan decision.
API_KEY_NO_APPROVAL.fix: Approve on a paired scanner with a staff PIN.

API_KEY_ORG_REQUIRED.title: Organization key required
API_KEY_ORG_REQUIRED.when: A platform key called a scan endpoint.
API_KEY_ORG_REQUIRED.fix: Call scan endpoints with a key scoped to one organization.

API_KEY_PARENT_RETIRING.title: Parent key retiring
API_KEY_PARENT_RETIRING.when: The key you called with is retiring, so it cannot create keys.
API_KEY_PARENT_RETIRING.fix: Create the key with a key that is not retiring.

API_KEY_REQUIRED.title: API key needed
API_KEY_REQUIRED.when: The route takes a key and got another credential.

API_KEY_RESTRICTED_ROUTE.title: Route outside key restriction
API_KEY_RESTRICTED_ROUTE.when: The key is limited to templates and cannot call this route.
API_KEY_RESTRICTED_ROUTE.fix: Call this route with a key that has no template restriction.

API_KEY_RESTRICTION_UNSUPPORTED.title: Restriction not supported
API_KEY_RESTRICTION_UNSUPPORTED.when: A templates or styles restriction was set on a key whose scopes it cannot narrow.
API_KEY_RESTRICTION_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Set templates and styles only on organization keys that hold pass, holder, template or NFC scopes.

API_KEY_RETIRE_SET.title: Key already retiring
API_KEY_RETIRE_SET.when: The key is already revoked or has a retirement date.
API_KEY_RETIRE_SET.fix: Leave the key as it is, or create a replacement with POST /api/v1/api-keys.

API_KEY_ROUTE.title: Route not open to keys
API_KEY_ROUTE.when: A key called a scanner route that keys cannot use.
API_KEY_ROUTE.fix: Call this route from a paired scanner or a signed-in session.

API_KEY_CREDENTIAL_LIVE_ORG.title: Credential scopes are live and one org
API_KEY_CREDENTIAL_LIVE_ORG.when: A test-mode key or a platform key asked for a credential scope (scanning:admin, nfc:keys or members:write).
API_KEY_CREDENTIAL_LIVE_ORG.fix: Mint the key in live mode, for that organization, with an expiry within 90 days.

API_KEY_SCAN_ORG_REQUIRED.title: Scan key needs an organization
API_KEY_SCAN_ORG_REQUIRED.when: A platform key was created with scan scopes.
API_KEY_SCAN_ORG_REQUIRED.fix: Create keys with scan scopes under an organization, not the platform.

API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_CREATOR.title: Scope beyond the creator
API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_CREATOR.when: The new key asks for scopes its creator does not hold.
API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_CREATOR.fix: Request only scopes your own key or role holds.

API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_SANDBOX.title: Scope not available in a sandbox
API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_SANDBOX.when: A sandbox key asked for, or holds, key minting, a terminal scope or scanning setup. issues names them.
API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_SANDBOX.fix: Request only sandbox scopes. A key that already holds one cannot be rolled: create a new key.

API_KEY_TERMINALS_REQUIRED.title: Terminals required
API_KEY_TERMINALS_REQUIRED.when: A key with the scans:write scope was created without terminals.
API_KEY_TERMINALS_REQUIRED.fix: Set terminals to at least one terminal.

API_KEY_TERMINALS_UNUSED.title: Terminals not allowed
API_KEY_TERMINALS_UNUSED.when: terminals was set on a key without the scans:write scope.
API_KEY_TERMINALS_UNUSED.fix: Remove terminals, or add the scans:write scope.

API_VERSION_UNKNOWN.title: Unknown API version
API_VERSION_UNKNOWN.when: The PassBook-Version header names a version that does not exist.
API_VERSION_UNKNOWN.fix: Send a version from GET /api/v1/versions, or omit the header.

ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE.title: Archive too large
ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE.when: The uploaded template archive is over 15 MB.
ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Remove unused files and upload an archive under 15 MB.

ASC_AUTH.title: Apple key rejected
ASC_AUTH.fix: Replace the provisioner key, then send the request again.

ASC_CERT_DER_MISSING.title: Apple listed a certificate without content
ASC_CERT_DER_MISSING.when: Apple listed a certificate without its content.
ASC_CERT_DER_MISSING.fix: Send the request again; contact support if it repeats.

ASC_CERT_MISSING.title: Apple sent no certificate
ASC_CERT_MISSING.when: Apple accepted the request but returned no certificate.
ASC_CERT_MISSING.fix: Send the request again; contact support if it repeats.

ASC_CONFLICT.title: Apple reports a conflict
ASC_CONFLICT.when: Apple refused the request because the resource already exists or is in use.
ASC_CONFLICT.fix: Check the resource in Apple Developer, then send the request again.

ASC_NOT_FOUND.title: Apple resource not found
ASC_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the identifier, then send the request again.

ASC_PASS_TYPE_MISSING.title: Pass type not recorded
ASC_PASS_TYPE_MISSING.when: The run has no recorded Apple pass type.
ASC_PASS_TYPE_MISSING.fix: Retry the run from the start.

ASC_REFUSED.title: Apple provisioner refused
ASC_REFUSED.when: The Apple provisioner refused the request.
ASC_REFUSED.fix: Check the request against the provisioner allowlist, then send it again.

ASC_UNAVAILABLE.title: Apple provisioner unavailable
ASC_UNAVAILABLE.when: The Apple provisioner is not configured.
ASC_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Ask the platform owner to configure it, then send the request again.

ASC_UPSTREAM.title: Apple request failed
ASC_UPSTREAM.fix: Send the request again in a minute.

ASSETS_INVALID.title: Invalid template assets
ASSETS_INVALID.when: An image in the template archive failed validation.
ASSETS_INVALID.fix: Fix the files named in issues and upload the archive again.

ASSET_DIMENSIONS.title: Image dimensions not allowed
ASSET_DIMENSIONS.when: The image's pixel size is outside what its slot accepts.
ASSET_DIMENSIONS.fix: Resize the image to the size named in issues and upload it again.

ASSET_NOT_FOUND.title: Image not found
ASSET_NOT_FOUND.when: No image with this name or id exists in this scope.
ASSET_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the image name or id and that it belongs to this organization.

ASSET_NOT_PNG.title: Image is not a readable PNG
ASSET_NOT_PNG.when: The upload is not a valid PNG, or uses a color format PassBook cannot read.
ASSET_NOT_PNG.fix: Re-export the image as a standard RGB or RGBA PNG and upload it again.

ASSET_SIZE.title: Image too large
ASSET_SIZE.fix: Compress the image below 1 MB and upload it again.

ASSET_SLOT.title: Unknown image slot
ASSET_SLOT.when: The image name does not match a slot on this pass or template.
ASSET_SLOT.fix: Use a slot name from the pass type's image slots in the request path.

AUDIT_LIMIT_TOO_HIGH.title: Audit page too large
AUDIT_LIMIT_TOO_HIGH.when: A key asked for more than 100 audit entries a page.
AUDIT_LIMIT_TOO_HIGH.fix: Send a limit of 100 or less and page with the cursor.

AUDIT_WINDOW_REQUIRED.title: Audit window missing
AUDIT_WINDOW_REQUIRED.when: A key read the audit log without from.
AUDIT_WINDOW_REQUIRED.fix: Send from, at most 90 days before to (to defaults to now).

AUDIT_WINDOW_TOO_WIDE.title: Audit window too wide
AUDIT_WINDOW_TOO_WIDE.when: A key asked for more than 90 days of the audit log at once.
AUDIT_WINDOW_TOO_WIDE.fix: Send a from at most 90 days before to, and read older entries in several windows.

AUTHORITY_DENIED.title: Not allowed here
AUTHORITY_DENIED.when: The caller lacks the authority this write needs.
AUTHORITY_DENIED.fix: Use a key with the scope the operation lists, or ask an org admin.

BLOCK_NOT_FOUND.title: Block not found
BLOCK_NOT_FOUND.when: No block with this id exists for the holder.
BLOCK_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the block id and send the request again.

BLUEPRINT_NOT_SCANNABLE.title: Blueprint not scannable
BLUEPRINT_NOT_SCANNABLE.when: Scan setup was requested on a blueprint instead of a template.
BLUEPRINT_NOT_SCANNABLE.fix: Create a template from the blueprint with POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/use, then set up scanning on it.

BRAND_ASSET_NOT_FOUND.title: Upload not staged
BRAND_ASSET_NOT_FOUND.when: The pass-setup save names an image sha that was never staged for that slot, or that expired after 24 hours.
BRAND_ASSET_NOT_FOUND.fix: Stage the PNG again with POST /api/v1/orgs/{orgId}/brand-assets and name the new sha.

BRAND_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.title: Brand image not found
BRAND_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.when: The organization has no stored image for this slot or hash.
BRAND_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Upload the image with PUT /api/v1/orgs/{id}/branding/{slot} and use the URL it returns.

BRAND_MARK_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Brand mark not on plan
BRAND_MARK_NOT_ALLOWED.when: The organization's plan does not include this branding setting.
BRAND_MARK_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Remove the setting, or ask the platform owner to enable it for the organization.

BROADCAST_EMPTY.title: No passes chosen
BROADCAST_EMPTY.when: The target names no template, pass or import.
BROADCAST_EMPTY.fix: Send templateIds, passIds or an importId.

BROADCAST_INVALID_INPUT.title: Invalid broadcast input
BROADCAST_INVALID_INPUT.when: A value in the broadcast's patch does not match the template's input schema.
BROADCAST_INVALID_INPUT.fix: Fix the values named in issues; GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema lists the allowed inputs.

BROADCAST_INVALID_OP.title: Change does not fit the field
BROADCAST_INVALID_OP.when: A change asks for a shift on a field that is not a date, an add on one that is not a number, or a clear on a required field.
BROADCAST_INVALID_OP.fix: Use set for text, shift for dates, add for numbers, and clear only for optional fields.

BROADCAST_NOT_CANCELLABLE.title: Broadcast not cancellable
BROADCAST_NOT_CANCELLABLE.when: The message has already started or finished; only drafts and scheduled messages cancel.
BROADCAST_NOT_CANCELLABLE.fix: Check the state with GET /api/v1/broadcasts/{id} and cancel only a draft or scheduled message.

BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.title: Broadcast is not a draft
BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.when: You tried to send a message that is not a draft.
BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.fix: Send only drafts, or create a new message with POST /api/v1/broadcasts.

BROADCAST_NOT_EDITABLE.title: Broadcast not editable
BROADCAST_NOT_EDITABLE.when: Only a draft or scheduled message can change; this one has started or finished.
BROADCAST_NOT_EDITABLE.fix: Create a new message with POST /api/v1/broadcasts instead.

BROADCAST_NOT_FOUND.title: Broadcast not found
BROADCAST_NOT_FOUND.when: No message with this id exists in this mode and organization.

BROADCAST_NOT_RETRYABLE.title: Broadcast not retryable
BROADCAST_NOT_RETRYABLE.when: Only a failed or cancelled message can be sent again.
BROADCAST_NOT_RETRYABLE.fix: Check the state with GET /api/v1/broadcasts/{id} and retry only a failed or cancelled message.

BROADCAST_NOT_SENDING.title: Not sending
BROADCAST_NOT_SENDING.when: Only a sending message or change can be stopped.

BROADCAST_NOT_UNDOABLE.title: Cannot be undone
BROADCAST_NOT_UNDOABLE.when: The run is not a finished change: it is a message, an undo, still sending, or never sent.
BROADCAST_NOT_UNDOABLE.fix: Stop a sending change first, then undo it.

BROADCAST_NO_RELEASE.title: No approved design
BROADCAST_NO_RELEASE.when: A template in the run has no approved release to move passes to.
BROADCAST_NO_RELEASE.fix: Approve and publish a release of the template, then run it again.

BROADCAST_ORG.title: Broadcast organization change
BROADCAST_ORG.when: The update tries to move the message to another organization.
BROADCAST_ORG.fix: Remove the organization change and update the message in its own organization.

BROADCAST_PASS_CHANGED.title: Pass changed since the run
BROADCAST_PASS_CHANGED.when: An undo found a pass whose input no longer holds the value the change set, so it kept the pass.
BROADCAST_PASS_CHANGED.fix: Edit the pass by hand if you still want the earlier value.

BROADCAST_PAST.title: Send time in the past
BROADCAST_PAST.when: The at time is not in the future.
BROADCAST_PAST.fix: Set at to a future time.

BROADCAST_TOO_FAR.title: Send time too far out
BROADCAST_TOO_FAR.when: The at time is more than a year away.
BROADCAST_TOO_FAR.fix: Set at to a time within the next year.

BROADCAST_TOO_MANY_TEMPLATES.title: Passes of too many templates
BROADCAST_TOO_MANY_TEMPLATES.when: The chosen passes belong to more than 20 templates.

BROADCAST_UNDO_EXPIRED.title: Undo window has passed
BROADCAST_UNDO_EXPIRED.when: A change can be undone for 24 hours after it ends.
BROADCAST_UNDO_EXPIRED.fix: Change the passes again by hand or with a new change.

BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_INPUT.title: Unknown broadcast input
BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_INPUT.when: The patch sets an input the target template does not have.
BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_INPUT.fix: Use only input names from GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema.

BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_TOKEN.title: Unknown field in the message
BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_TOKEN.when: The message has a {Label} token that no field of the targeted templates carries.
BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_TOKEN.fix: Use a field label as the form shows it, or remove the token.

BROADCAST_UNSUPPORTED_FILTER.title: Unsupported target filter
BROADCAST_UNSUPPORTED_FILTER.when: The target has a key it does not define, such as status, holderEmail, externalId, connectionId or templateId. The key is refused, never dropped, so a run cannot reach more passes than you asked for.
BROADCAST_UNSUPPORTED_FILTER.fix: Remove the key and filter by templateIds, onDevice, holderState, q, scan or match. To change passes by a filter the target lacks, list the passes with it and send their ids as passIds; a message takes templates only.

BULK_RUN_ACTIVE.title: Bulk run active
BULK_RUN_ACTIVE.when: Another bulk run on these passes is still in progress.
BULK_RUN_ACTIVE.fix: Wait for the running job to finish, then start the new one.

BUNDLE_DUPLICATE_PASS.title: Duplicate pass in bundle
BUNDLE_DUPLICATE_PASS.when: The same pass id appears twice in the bundle.

BUNDLE_EMPTY.title: No passes to bundle
BUNDLE_EMPTY.when: The bundle has no passes to add.
BUNDLE_EMPTY.fix: Add at least one pass to the bundle.

BUNDLE_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Bundle mode mismatch
BUNDLE_MODE_MISMATCH.when: The bundle mixes live and test passes.
BUNDLE_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Put only passes of the bundle's mode in it.

BUNDLE_NOT_FOUND.title: Bundle not found
BUNDLE_NOT_FOUND.when: No bundle with this id exists in this mode and organization.

BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE.title: Bundle too large
BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE.when: The bundle's passes exceed the size limit for one download.
BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Split the passes across smaller bundles.

BUNDLE_TOO_MANY.title: Too many passes in bundle
BUNDLE_TOO_MANY.when: The bundle lists more than 10 passes.
BUNDLE_TOO_MANY.fix: Send at most 10 passes per bundle.

CAPTURED_EMAIL_NOT_FOUND.title: Test email not found
CAPTURED_EMAIL_NOT_FOUND.when: No captured email with this id exists in the test inbox.
CAPTURED_EMAIL_NOT_FOUND.fix: List emails with GET /api/v1/test-inbox and use an id from the result.

CAPTURE_DEVELOPER_ONLY.title: Capture needs a sandbox
CAPTURE_DEVELOPER_ONLY.when: You asked for a capture endpoint outside a developer sandbox, or in Live mode.
CAPTURE_DEVELOPER_ONLY.fix: Make your sandbox in the developer portal and call this in Test mode.

CAPTURE_NOT_STORED.title: Capture was not stored
CAPTURE_NOT_STORED.when: The capture was written but could not be read back.

CAPTURE_TOO_LARGE.title: Capture too large
CAPTURE_TOO_LARGE.when: The request body is over 256 KiB, the most a capture keeps.

CAPTURE_URL_FIXED.title: Capture endpoint has no URL
CAPTURE_URL_FIXED.when: You tried to set the URL of a capture endpoint, which stores requests and has none.
CAPTURE_URL_FIXED.fix: Leave the url out, or create a URL endpoint instead.

CERT_NOT_PENDING.title: Certificate not pending
CERT_NOT_PENDING.when: The certificate is no longer pending.
CERT_NOT_PENDING.fix: Refresh the identity and start a new certificate request if needed.

CERT_PENDING_KEY_MISSING.title: Pending key missing
CERT_PENDING_KEY_MISSING.when: The key for the pending certificate is gone.

CERT_PENDING_NOT_FOUND.title: No pending certificate
CERT_PENDING_NOT_FOUND.when: The identity has no pending certificate.
CERT_PENDING_NOT_FOUND.fix: Start a certificate request, then upload the certificate.

CHANNEL_REPLACE_ALL_OFF.title: No channel left on
CHANNEL_REPLACE_ALL_OFF.when: The change would turn every channel off.
CHANNEL_REPLACE_ALL_OFF.fix: Keep at least one channel on.

CHANNEL_REPLACE_WINDOW_OPEN.title: Replace window open
CHANNEL_REPLACE_WINDOW_OPEN.when: A channel replacement is already open for this pass.
CHANNEL_REPLACE_WINDOW_OPEN.fix: Finish or wait for it to close, then send the request again.

CONFLICT.title: Conflict
CONFLICT.when: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
CONFLICT.fix: Read the resource again and adjust the request.

CONNECTION_CONFLICT.title: Connection changed
CONNECTION_CONFLICT.when: Another request changed the connection while yours was running.
CONNECTION_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/connections/{id} and send the change again.

CONNECTION_DISABLED.title: Connection disabled
CONNECTION_DISABLED.when: The connection is disabled, so it cannot run this action.
CONNECTION_DISABLED.fix: Enable it with PATCH /api/v1/connections/{id}, then send the request again.

CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND.title: Connection not found
CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND.when: No connection with this id exists in this mode and organization.

CONNECTION_ORG.title: Connection in another organization
CONNECTION_ORG.when: The connection belongs to a different organization than the pass.
CONNECTION_ORG.fix: Use a connection id from your own organization's GET /api/v1/connections.

CONNECTION_TRANSFER_PENDING.title: Holder transfer pending
CONNECTION_TRANSFER_PENDING.when: The holder is moving between providers and the old provider has not retired yet.
CONNECTION_TRANSFER_PENDING.fix: Wait for the transfer to finish, then send the request again.

CONNECTOR_NOT_FOUND.title: Connector type not found
CONNECTOR_NOT_FOUND.when: No connector type has this name.

CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN.title: Unknown connector type
CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN.when: The connection's type is not a known connector.
CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN.fix: Set type to a value from GET /api/v1/connectors.

CONSOLE_ACCESS_REQUIRED.title: Console access required
CONSOLE_ACCESS_REQUIRED.when: The platform requires the admin group for organization console routes, and this session has neither the group nor platform admin.
CONSOLE_ACCESS_REQUIRED.fix: Ask an administrator to add you to the admin group in Polaris ID, then sign in again.

CREATE_STALE.title: Pass create raced
CREATE_STALE.when: Another pass was created with this externalId while yours was being created.
CREATE_STALE.fix: Look the pass up by externalId with GET /api/v1/passes and update it instead of creating it again.

CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE.title: Credential references unavailable
CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE.when: The server's credential-reference keyset is not configured right now.
CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Retry with backoff; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_UNAVAILABLE.title: Credential references unavailable
CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_UNAVAILABLE.when: The stored credential-reference keyset could not be loaded.
CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Retry with backoff; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

CSRF_ORIGIN.title: Cross-origin request blocked
CSRF_ORIGIN.when: A browser session request came from an origin other than PassBook's own.
CSRF_ORIGIN.fix: Call the API server-side with an API key in the Authorization header instead of from a browser page.

DELIVERY_PENDING.title: Delivery already queued
DELIVERY_PENDING.when: The delivery you replay is already waiting to be sent.
DELIVERY_PENDING.fix: Wait for it to send, then check GET /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/deliveries before replaying.

DELIVERY_STALE.title: Delivery stale
DELIVERY_STALE.fix: Review the recipient and try again.

DEVELOPER_ACCESS_REQUIRED.title: Developer access required
DEVELOPER_ACCESS_REQUIRED.when: A signed-in person without developer access called a developer sandbox or Try it route.
DEVELOPER_ACCESS_REQUIRED.fix: Ask an administrator to add you to the developer group in Polaris ID, then sign in again.

DEVICE_REQUIRED.title: Terminal not named
DEVICE_REQUIRED.when: A scan call from a key did not say which terminal scanned, or a key opened a device connection.
DEVICE_REQUIRED.fix: Name the terminal in the device header on scan calls; open live connections from a paired scanner.

DEVICE_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE.title: Device token unavailable
DEVICE_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE.when: The pass's device authentication token could not be built.
DEVICE_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Retry the request; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

EMAIL_INVALID.title: Invalid email address
EMAIL_INVALID.when: The email value is not a valid address.
EMAIL_INVALID.fix: Send a valid address in the email field.

EMAIL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.title: Email outcome unknown
EMAIL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.when: The mail provider did not confirm whether the earlier send went out.
EMAIL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.fix: Check the pass's delivery status before sending again, to avoid a duplicate email.

EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED.title: Email rate limited
EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED.when: The request ran into email rate limited.

ENROLLMENT_ENDED.title: Enrollment already ended
ENROLLMENT_ENDED.when: The device or tag enrollment request was already approved, denied or cancelled.

ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Enrollment not found
ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND.when: No enrollment request with this id exists in this mode and organization.
ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the enrollment id and start a new request if it expired.

ENTITLEMENTS_CHANGED.title: Entitlements changed
ENTITLEMENTS_CHANGED.when: Another request changed the organization's features while yours was running.
ENTITLEMENTS_CHANGED.fix: Fetch them with GET /api/v1/orgs/{id}/entitlements and send your change again.

EVENT_ARCHIVED.title: Event archived
EVENT_ARCHIVED.when: The event is archived and cannot be used or changed.
EVENT_ARCHIVED.fix: Use an event that is not archived, or create a new one.

EVENT_IN_USE.title: Event in use
EVENT_IN_USE.when: A scanning session still uses this event.
EVENT_IN_USE.fix: End or change the sessions that use the event, then send the request again.

EVENT_MATCH_INPUT.title: Event match input missing
EVENT_MATCH_INPUT.when: The event's match input does not name a single-value input on its template.
EVENT_MATCH_INPUT.fix: Set the match input to a single-value input from GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema.

EVENT_NEEDS_CAPACITY.title: Event needs a capacity
EVENT_NEEDS_CAPACITY.when: The setting needs a capacity and the event has none.
EVENT_NEEDS_CAPACITY.fix: Set the event's capacity, then send the request again.

EVENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Event not found
EVENT_NOT_FOUND.when: No event with this id exists in this mode and organization.

EVENT_TEMPLATE_NO_CHECK_IN.title: Template has no check-in
EVENT_TEMPLATE_NO_CHECK_IN.when: The event's template has no check-in action.
EVENT_TEMPLATE_NO_CHECK_IN.fix: Pick a template that defines check-in, or add the action to this one.

EVENT_TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.title: Template release required
EVENT_TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.when: An event template needs an approved release or an eligible legacy pass in this mode.
EVENT_TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.fix: Approve a release for the template with POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/releases, then retry.

EXPECT_COUNT_REQUIRED.title: Send the count left
EXPECT_COUNT_REQUIRED.when: Resuming a change needs expectCount: the passes it has left.
EXPECT_COUNT_REQUIRED.fix: Preview the remainder, then retry with ?expectCount=<count>.

EXPIRY_PAST.title: Expiry in the past
EXPIRY_PAST.when: expiresAt is not in the future.
EXPIRY_PAST.fix: Send a future time in milliseconds.

EXTERNAL_ID_TAKEN.title: externalId in use
EXTERNAL_ID_TAKEN.when: Another pass of this template has that externalId.
EXTERNAL_ID_TAKEN.fix: Send a new externalId, or PATCH the existing pass.

FEATURE_LIMIT_REACHED.title: Plan limit reached
FEATURE_LIMIT_REACHED.when: The organization is at the cap its plan sets for this feature.
FEATURE_LIMIT_REACHED.fix: Remove something the plan counts, or ask an admin to raise the limit.

FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED.title: Not in your plan
FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED.when: The organization does not have the feature this call uses.
FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED.fix: Ask an org admin to enable the feature, then send the request again.

FORBIDDEN.title: Not allowed
FORBIDDEN.when: The key is valid but may not do this.
FORBIDDEN.fix: Use a key with the scope the operation lists, or ask an org admin.

GOOGLE_CALLBACK_INVALID.title: Google callback invalid
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_INVALID.when: A Google Wallet callback failed signature or format checks.
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_INVALID.fix: Send callbacks only from Google; check the callback URL set in Google Wallet.

GOOGLE_CALLBACK_UNAVAILABLE.title: Google callback unavailable
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_UNAVAILABLE.when: The service that processes Google Wallet callbacks is down.
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Retry with backoff; Google resends failed callbacks.

GOOGLE_ISSUER_NOT_OWNED.title: Issuer not yours
GOOGLE_ISSUER_NOT_OWNED.when: The Google issuer is not owned by the account that shared it.
GOOGLE_ISSUER_NOT_OWNED.fix: Share an issuer your Google account owns, then send the request again.

GOOGLE_ISSUER_NOT_SHARED.title: Issuer not shared
GOOGLE_ISSUER_NOT_SHARED.when: The Google issuer is not shared with the platform account.
GOOGLE_ISSUER_NOT_SHARED.fix: Share the issuer in the Google Pay and Wallet console, then send the request again.

GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Google unavailable
GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Send the request again in a minute.

GROUP_ENTRY_ONLY.title: Check in all needs an entry scanner
GROUP_ENTRY_ONLY.when: Check in all was used on a scanner that is not an entry scanner.
GROUP_ENTRY_ONLY.fix: Use check in all only on an entry scanner.

HOLDER_CHANGED.title: Holder changed
HOLDER_CHANGED.when: The pass's holder changed while your request ran.
HOLDER_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the pass with GET /api/v1/passes/{id} and send the request again.

HOLDER_EMAIL_INVALID.title: Holder email invalid
HOLDER_EMAIL_INVALID.when: The email on the upstream record is not a valid address.
HOLDER_EMAIL_INVALID.fix: Correct the email in the source system, then sync the connection again.

HOLDER_OWNED.title: Pass already has an owner
HOLDER_OWNED.when: The pass is already owned by a user, so it cannot be assigned.

HOLDER_TRANSFER_PENDING.title: Holder transfer pending
HOLDER_TRANSFER_PENDING.when: A holder transfer on this pass has not finished.
HOLDER_TRANSFER_PENDING.fix: Wait for the transfer to finish, then send the request again.

IAM_BAD_ACCOUNT.title: Bad service account
IAM_BAD_ACCOUNT.when: Google returned a service account that is not valid.
IAM_BAD_ACCOUNT.fix: Send the request again; contact support if it repeats.

IAM_BAD_KEY.title: Bad service account key
IAM_BAD_KEY.when: Google returned a service account key that is not usable.
IAM_BAD_KEY.fix: Send the request again; contact support if it repeats.

IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.title: First request still running
IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.when: A request with this Idempotency-Key has not finished.
IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.fix: Wait a moment and resend the identical request.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.title: Bad Idempotency-Key
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.when: Idempotency-Key is empty or longer than 200 characters.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.fix: Send a unique string of 1 to 200 characters, such as a UUID.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.title: Idempotency-Key required
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.when: A release without dryRun came without an Idempotency-Key header.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.fix: Send a unique string of 1 to 200 characters, such as a UUID, and reuse it to retry.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_RESERVED.title: Idempotency-Key reserved
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_RESERVED.when: On POST /passes the key starts with broadcast-create:, bulk-send: or rollout-tell:, which the server uses itself; on POST /broadcasts rollout-tell: is only for Tell holders on the active release.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.title: Idempotency-Key reused
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.when: The same Idempotency-Key came with a different request.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.fix: Use a new key for a new request; resend the identical request to replay.

IDENTITY_ALREADY_PROVISIONED.title: Already provisioned
IDENTITY_ALREADY_PROVISIONED.when: The identity already has a certificate.
IDENTITY_ALREADY_PROVISIONED.fix: Renew it instead of provisioning again.

IDENTITY_CERT_CAP.title: Certificate limit reached
IDENTITY_CERT_CAP.when: Apple allows no more certificates for this pass type.
IDENTITY_CERT_CAP.fix: Revoke an old certificate, then send the request again.

IDENTITY_CERT_NOT_FOUND.title: Certificate not found
IDENTITY_CERT_NOT_FOUND.when: No certificate with that id belongs to the identity.
IDENTITY_CERT_NOT_FOUND.fix: List the identity's certificates and use an id from the list.

IDENTITY_CERT_NOT_REVOCABLE.title: Certificate cannot be revoked
IDENTITY_CERT_NOT_REVOCABLE.when: Only a superseded certificate that Apple issued can be revoked.
IDENTITY_CERT_NOT_REVOCABLE.fix: Pick a superseded certificate from the identity's history.

IDENTITY_CHANGED.title: Identity changed
IDENTITY_CHANGED.when: The identity changed while its certificate was being activated.
IDENTITY_CHANGED.fix: Reload the identity, then activate again.

IDENTITY_CONFIRM_MISMATCH.title: Confirmation does not match
IDENTITY_CONFIRM_MISMATCH.when: The confirmation does not match the pass type ID.
IDENTITY_CONFIRM_MISMATCH.fix: Send the pass type ID exactly as shown.

IDENTITY_EXPIRED.title: Identity expired
IDENTITY_EXPIRED.when: The signing identity certificate has expired.
IDENTITY_EXPIRED.fix: Upload a renewed certificate, then send the request again.

IDENTITY_HANDLE_ADMIN_ONLY.title: Handle set by PassBook
IDENTITY_HANDLE_ADMIN_ONLY.when: Only PassBook can choose the handle.
IDENTITY_HANDLE_ADMIN_ONLY.fix: Leave the handle out; it comes from the organization slug.

IDENTITY_HANDLE_FIXED.title: Handle is fixed
IDENTITY_HANDLE_FIXED.when: The organization already has a handle.
IDENTITY_HANDLE_FIXED.fix: Leave the handle out or send the existing one.

IDENTITY_HANDLE_INVALID.title: Invalid handle
IDENTITY_HANDLE_INVALID.when: The handle is not 2 to 30 lowercase letters or digits.
IDENTITY_HANDLE_INVALID.fix: Use 2 to 30 lowercase letters or digits, then send the request again.

IDENTITY_HANDLE_RESERVED.title: Handle reserved
IDENTITY_HANDLE_RESERVED.when: The handle is reserved by the platform.

IDENTITY_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: Identity not set up
IDENTITY_NOT_CONFIGURED.when: The organization has no signing identity for this pass type.
IDENTITY_NOT_CONFIGURED.fix: Add an identity in Admin, then send the request again.

IDENTITY_NOT_FOUND.title: Signing identity not found
IDENTITY_NOT_FOUND.when: No signing identity with this id exists in this mode and organization.

IDENTITY_NOT_READY.title: Identity not ready
IDENTITY_NOT_READY.when: The identity has no certificate yet.
IDENTITY_NOT_READY.fix: Wait for provisioning to finish, then send the request again.

IDENTITY_NOT_ROTATABLE.title: Identity cannot renew automatically
IDENTITY_NOT_ROTATABLE.when: Only a managed or platform identity with a certificate renews automatically.
IDENTITY_NOT_ROTATABLE.fix: Set rotation to manual, or upload a certificate.

IDENTITY_PLATFORM_ENV_MISMATCH.title: Platform identity mismatch
IDENTITY_PLATFORM_ENV_MISMATCH.when: The platform identity row does not match the deployed signing identity.
IDENTITY_PLATFORM_ENV_MISMATCH.fix: Ask the platform owner to align the deployed identity with the database.

IDENTITY_PTI_TAKEN.title: Pass type taken
IDENTITY_PTI_TAKEN.when: The pass type belongs to another identity.

IDENTITY_REISSUE_PENDING.title: Reissue pending
IDENTITY_REISSUE_PENDING.when: The identity's passes are not reissued yet and 72 hours have not passed since the renewal.
IDENTITY_REISSUE_PENDING.fix: Reissue the identity's passes or wait 72 hours, then send the request again.

IDENTITY_RETIRED.title: Identity retired
IDENTITY_RETIRED.when: The signing identity no longer issues passes.
IDENTITY_RETIRED.fix: Choose another identity, then send the request again.

IDENTITY_RUN_CLOSED.title: Run finished
IDENTITY_RUN_CLOSED.when: The run has already finished or was cancelled.

IDENTITY_PASS_TYPE_MISMATCH.title: Pass type mismatch
IDENTITY_PASS_TYPE_MISMATCH.when: Apple returned a pass type that is not the one reserved for this organization's handle.
IDENTITY_PASS_TYPE_MISMATCH.fix: Contact support; the run stopped before any certificate was ordered.

IDENTITY_RUN_INCOMPLETE.title: Run incomplete
IDENTITY_RUN_INCOMPLETE.when: The run is missing data a step needs.

IDENTITY_RUN_NOT_FOUND.title: Run not found
IDENTITY_RUN_NOT_FOUND.when: No provisioning run with that id exists for you.
IDENTITY_RUN_NOT_FOUND.fix: List runs and use an id from the list.

IDENTITY_RUN_OPEN.title: Run still open
IDENTITY_RUN_OPEN.when: Only a failed or cancelled run can be retried.
IDENTITY_RUN_OPEN.fix: Wait for the run to end, or cancel it, then retry.

IDP_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.title: Polaris ID sign-in required
IDP_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.when: A session made with an email link called a console or developer route. Only a Polaris ID sign-in opens them.
IDP_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.fix: Sign in with Polaris ID at the signInUrl in the problem, then send the request again. API keys are not affected.

IF_MATCH_INVALID.title: Bad If-Match
IF_MATCH_INVALID.when: If-Match is not a pass version number.
IF_MATCH_INVALID.fix: Send the version from the last GET, for example If-Match: 3.

IMAGE_BYTES.title: Image file too large
IMAGE_BYTES.when: A brand image is over its size limit (200 KB for slots, 512 KB for the web logo).
IMAGE_BYTES.fix: Compress the image and upload it again.

IMAGE_INVALID.title: Image invalid
IMAGE_INVALID.when: The upload is not a valid PNG.
IMAGE_INVALID.fix: Export a standard PNG and upload it again.

IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.title: Image not found
IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.when: The organization has no image for this slot.

IMAGE_SCALE.title: Image scales do not match
IMAGE_SCALE.when: The @2x image is not two thirds the size of the @3x image.
IMAGE_SCALE.fix: Resize so the @2x image is two thirds of the @3x, then upload both.

IMAGE_SIZE.title: Image size not allowed
IMAGE_SIZE.when: The image's pixel size is outside what the slot accepts.
IMAGE_SIZE.fix: Resize to the size named in issues and upload it again.

IMPORT_BUSY.title: Import already running
IMPORT_BUSY.when: This import, or another import of the same template, is running.
IMPORT_BUSY.fix: Wait for it to finish with GET /api/v1/pass-imports/{id}, then retry.

IMPORT_COLUMN_MISSING.title: Import column missing
IMPORT_COLUMN_MISSING.when: The file has no column for a field the mapping needs.
IMPORT_COLUMN_MISSING.fix: Add the column to the file, or change the mapping, then check again.

IMPORT_CONFLICT.title: Import not queued
IMPORT_CONFLICT.when: The import could not be queued.

IMPORT_EMPTY.title: Empty tag file
IMPORT_EMPTY.when: The uploaded CSV has no rows.
IMPORT_EMPTY.fix: Upload a CSV with a header line and one tag per row.

IMPORT_EXPIRED.title: Import expired
IMPORT_EXPIRED.when: The import's checked file expired before you committed it.
IMPORT_EXPIRED.fix: Upload the file again with POST /api/v1/pass-imports.

IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS.title: Import has errors
IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS.when: Some rows have errors and the import is set to stop on errors.
IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS.fix: Fix the rows listed in GET /api/v1/pass-imports/{id}/errors.csv, or skip them, then commit again.

IMPORT_HEADER.title: Tag file header missing
IMPORT_HEADER.when: The CSV's first line has no uid and key columns.
IMPORT_HEADER.fix: Start the file with a header line naming the uid and key columns.

IMPORT_HEADER_TOO_LONG.title: Import header too long
IMPORT_HEADER_TOO_LONG.when: A column header in the file is over the length limit.
IMPORT_HEADER_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the header and upload the file again.

IMPORT_ID_TAKEN.title: Import pass id taken
IMPORT_ID_TAKEN.when: The pass id reserved for an import row is already used by another pass.
IMPORT_ID_TAKEN.fix: Check the import again with POST /api/v1/pass-imports/{id}/check, then commit.

IMPORT_MAPPINGS_FULL.title: Too many saved mappings
IMPORT_MAPPINGS_FULL.when: The template already has 20 saved import mappings and the request names a new one.
IMPORT_MAPPINGS_FULL.fix: Delete a saved mapping with DELETE /api/v1/pass-imports/mappings, or reuse an existing name to replace it.

IMPORT_NOT_ENDED.title: Import not ended
IMPORT_NOT_ENDED.when: The import is still running, or was undone, so the passes it made are not fixed.
IMPORT_NOT_ENDED.fix: Wait for the import to finish, or choose passes another way.

IMPORT_NOT_FOUND.title: Import not found
IMPORT_NOT_FOUND.when: No import with this id exists in this mode and organization.

IMPORT_PASS_CHANGED.title: Imported pass edited
IMPORT_PASS_CHANGED.when: The pass was edited after the import, so it cannot be removed with it.
IMPORT_PASS_CHANGED.fix: Remove the pass on its own with POST /api/v1/passes/{id}/remove.

IMPORT_PASS_GONE.title: Pass already gone
IMPORT_PASS_GONE.when: An undo found a pass the import made that was removed or deleted since.
IMPORT_PASS_GONE.fix: Nothing to do; the pass is already out of Wallet.

IMPORT_PLAN_INVALID.title: Import mapping invalid
IMPORT_PLAN_INVALID.when: The column mapping does not match the template's inputs.
IMPORT_PLAN_INVALID.fix: Fix the mapping entries named in issues and check again.

IMPORT_ROW_UNRESERVED.title: Import row has no pass
IMPORT_ROW_UNRESERVED.when: The server did not reserve a pass id for an import row.
IMPORT_ROW_UNRESERVED.fix: Retry the commit; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

IMPORT_STATE.title: Import in the wrong state
IMPORT_STATE.when: The import is not in a state that allows this action, such as results before it ran.
IMPORT_STATE.fix: Check its state with GET /api/v1/pass-imports/{id} and call the action that state allows.

IMPORT_TOO_MANY.title: Tag file too large
IMPORT_TOO_MANY.when: The CSV has more rows than one import takes.
IMPORT_TOO_MANY.fix: Split the file and import it in parts.

IMPORT_UNDONE.title: Import was undone
IMPORT_UNDONE.when: The import was undone or is being undone, so it can no longer be checked, committed or discarded.
IMPORT_UNDONE.fix: Upload the file again as a new import.

IMPORT_UNDO_EXPIRED.title: Undo window has passed
IMPORT_UNDO_EXPIRED.when: The import ended more than 24 hours ago, so it can no longer be undone.
IMPORT_UNDO_EXPIRED.fix: Remove or change the passes one by one, or run a change that sets the earlier values.

IMPORT_UNDO_NO_BEFORE.title: Earlier values not kept
IMPORT_UNDO_NO_BEFORE.when: An undo found an updated row from an import that ran before undo kept earlier values.
IMPORT_UNDO_NO_BEFORE.fix: Change the pass by hand or import the earlier values again.

IMPORT_UNDO_RUNNING.title: Undo is running
IMPORT_UNDO_RUNNING.when: The import is being undone, so its held mail cannot be sent now.
IMPORT_UNDO_RUNNING.fix: Wait for the undo to finish, then read the result from GET /api/v1/pass-imports/{id}.

INVALID_API_KEY.title: Invalid API key
INVALID_API_KEY.when: The key is unknown, revoked or expired.
INVALID_API_KEY.fix: Create a new key in the console and update PASSBOOK_KEY.

INVALID_CURSOR.title: Bad cursor
INVALID_CURSOR.when: cursor is not one a list returned.
INVALID_CURSOR.fix: Pass the nextCursor from the previous page unchanged, or drop it to start over.

INVALID_INPUT.title: Invalid pass input
INVALID_INPUT.when: The pass input does not match the template's input schema.
INVALID_INPUT.fix: Fix the inputs named in issues; GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema lists them.

INVALID_SETTING.title: Setting not accepted
INVALID_SETTING.when: A setting value is outside what the setting allows.
INVALID_SETTING.fix: Read the problem's issues for the setting and value, correct it, then send the request again.

INVITATION_INVALID.title: Invitation invalid
INVITATION_INVALID.when: The invitation token is wrong, used or expired.
INVITATION_INVALID.fix: Ask an organization admin to send a new invitation with POST /api/v1/orgs/{id}/invitations.

INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH.title: Invitation is for another address
INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH.when: The signed-in account does not hold the invited address, verified.
INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH.fix: Sign in with the invited address, or ask for an invitation to the address you use.

INVITATION_CONFLICT.title: Invitation could not be accepted
INVITATION_CONFLICT.when: Part of the acceptance could not land, for example the person is already a member. Nothing was changed.
INVITATION_CONFLICT.fix: Check the person's memberships and developer access, then ask for a new invitation if needed.

INVITATION_SETUP_CAPPED.title: Too many Polaris ID links
INVITATION_SETUP_CAPPED.when: The invitation already made three Polaris ID signup links.
INVITATION_SETUP_CAPPED.fix: Ask an organization admin to send a new invitation.

INVITATION_NO_ACCOUNT.title: No Polaris ID for this address
INVITATION_NO_ACCOUNT.when: No Polaris ID account has the invited address verified.
INVITATION_NO_ACCOUNT.fix: Create a Polaris ID from the invitation page.

INVITATION_CLAIM_CAPPED.title: Too many accounts tried this invitation
INVITATION_CLAIM_CAPPED.when: Three accounts already claimed this invitation.
INVITATION_CLAIM_CAPPED.fix: Ask an organization admin to send a new invitation.

DEVELOPER_LIMIT_REACHED.title: No developer seats left
DEVELOPER_LIMIT_REACHED.when: Accepting would put the organization over its developer limit.
DEVELOPER_LIMIT_REACHED.fix: Ask the organization to remove a developer or raise the limit, then accept again.

INVITATION_PENDING.title: Invitation pending
INVITATION_PENDING.when: This address already has a pending invitation.
INVITATION_PENDING.fix: Revoke it to send a new one.

JOIN_NOT_READY.title: Join link not ready
JOIN_NOT_READY.when: The template is not ready for a join link, for example it has no published version.
JOIN_NOT_READY.fix: Publish the template, then enable the link with PUT /api/v1/join-links/{templateId}.

KEYSET_CHANGED.title: Keyset changed
KEYSET_CHANGED.when: The NFC keyset changed while your request ran, or it has no active key.
KEYSET_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the keyset and send the change again.

KEYSET_KEY_INVALID.title: Keyset key invalid
KEYSET_KEY_INVALID.when: A key is not 32 hex digits.
KEYSET_KEY_INVALID.fix: Send each key as 32 hexadecimal characters.

KEYSET_KEY_NOT_FOUND.title: Keyset key version not found
KEYSET_KEY_NOT_FOUND.when: The keyset has no key with this version.
KEYSET_KEY_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the key version against the keyset's list and send it again.

KEYSET_KEY_REUSED.title: Keyset key reused
KEYSET_KEY_REUSED.when: A key was already used by this organization.
KEYSET_KEY_REUSED.fix: Send new keys this organization has never used.

KEYSET_KEY_WEAK.title: Keyset key too weak
KEYSET_KEY_WEAK.when: The two keys are the same, or one is the factory default.
KEYSET_KEY_WEAK.fix: Send two different, randomly generated keys.

KEYSET_NOT_FOUND.title: Keyset not found
KEYSET_NOT_FOUND.when: No NFC keyset with this id exists in this mode and organization.
KEYSET_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the keyset id and the key's mode.

KEY_CREATOR_GONE.title: Key creator deleted
KEY_CREATOR_GONE.when: The user who created this key no longer exists.
KEY_CREATOR_GONE.fix: Create a new key with POST /api/v1/api-keys.

KEY_CREATOR_NOT_MEMBER.title: Key creator left the organization
KEY_CREATOR_NOT_MEMBER.when: The user who created this key is no longer a member of the organization.
KEY_CREATOR_NOT_MEMBER.fix: Create a new key from a current member with POST /api/v1/api-keys.

KEY_OWNER_NEEDS_IDP.title: Key owner needs Polaris ID
KEY_OWNER_NEEDS_IDP.when: A personal key's owner has never signed in with Polaris ID, and the email sign-in grace period for the console has ended.
KEY_OWNER_NEEDS_IDP.fix: Ask the key's owner to sign in with Polaris ID once. The key then works again unchanged.

KEY_TEST_ONLY.title: Test key only
KEY_TEST_ONLY.when: The operation is limited to Test keys.

LAST_ORG_ADMIN.title: Last org admin
LAST_ORG_ADMIN.when: This is the last org admin.
LAST_ORG_ADMIN.fix: Make someone else an org admin first.

LINEAGE_CHANGED.title: Template lineage changed
LINEAGE_CHANGED.when: The template was replaced by another lineage while the request ran.
LINEAGE_CHANGED.fix: Reload the template and send the request again.

LINK_NOT_FOUND.title: Link not found
LINK_NOT_FOUND.when: The link token is unknown, rotated or expired.
LINK_NOT_FOUND.fix: Request a fresh link, for example with POST /api/v1/bundles/{id}/rotate-link.

MANIFEST_INVALID.title: Manifest invalid
MANIFEST_INVALID.when: wallet.template.json is missing, not valid JSON or fails the manifest schema.
MANIFEST_INVALID.fix: Fix the manifest fields listed in issues and upload it again.

MATCH_NEEDS_TEMPLATE.title: Input filter needs a template
MATCH_NEEDS_TEMPLATE.when: The pass list filters by input without naming an organization and template.
MATCH_NEEDS_TEMPLATE.fix: Send orgId and templateId with the input filter.

MEMBERSHIP_CONFLICT.title: Membership conflict
MEMBERSHIP_CONFLICT.when: The membership changed while the request ran.
MEMBERSHIP_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/orgs/{id}/memberships and send the change again.

MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND.title: Member not found
MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND.when: The membership is not an active member of this organization.
MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND.fix: List the members again and use the current membership id.

MEMBER_PHOTO_CHANGED.title: Member photo changed
MEMBER_PHOTO_CHANGED.when: The pass or its photo changed while the photo was saving.
MEMBER_PHOTO_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the pass with GET /api/v1/passes/{id} and save the photo again.

MEMBER_PHOTO_DIMENSIONS.title: Member photo size wrong
MEMBER_PHOTO_DIMENSIONS.when: The photo is not the required square size.
MEMBER_PHOTO_DIMENSIONS.fix: Crop the photo to a 270 by 270 pixel square and upload it again.

MEMBER_PHOTO_ENCODING.title: Member photo unreadable
MEMBER_PHOTO_ENCODING.when: The photo file could not be decoded as an image.
MEMBER_PHOTO_ENCODING.fix: Send the photo as a PNG or JPEG file.

MEMBER_PHOTO_NOT_FOUND.title: Member photo not found
MEMBER_PHOTO_NOT_FOUND.when: The pass has no member photo.

MEMBER_PHOTO_STYLE.title: Pass style cannot hold a photo
MEMBER_PHOTO_STYLE.when: A member photo needs a generic or event ticket pass without a strip image.
MEMBER_PHOTO_STYLE.fix: Use a template of that style, or remove the strip image.

MESSAGING_UNSUPPORTED.title: Template has no message field
MESSAGING_UNSUPPORTED.when: The template has no message field to update.
MESSAGING_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Use a template that defines a message field, or add one to it.

MISSING_SCOPE.title: Missing scope
MISSING_SCOPE.when: The key lacks a scope this operation needs.
MISSING_SCOPE.fix: Create a key with the scope the operation lists under security.

MODE_LIVE_REQUIRED.title: Live key required
MODE_LIVE_REQUIRED.when: A Test key tried to change state that Live also reads (the brand kit, setup, zones, tag types, saved import mappings or members) in an organization that also has Live passes. A sandbox organization allows it. Template authoring is the exception: a Test key may clone and request review of templates, which changes no Live pass.
MODE_LIVE_REQUIRED.fix: Use a live key for this change.

MODE_MISMATCH.title: Mode mismatch
MODE_MISMATCH.when: The request mixes test and live objects, for example a test pass with a live connection.
MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Use objects and a key of the same mode.

MODE_UNSUPPORTED.title: Mode not supported
MODE_UNSUPPORTED.when: The connector does not support the requested mode.
MODE_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Create the connection in a mode the connector supports; GET /api/v1/connectors/{type} lists them.

NEW_CODE_UNSUPPORTED.title: New code not supported
NEW_CODE_UNSUPPORTED.when: The pass's barcode is not its scan code, so a new code cannot replace it.
NEW_CODE_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Reissue the pass with POST /api/v1/passes/bulk-reissue instead of requesting a new code.

NOTE_CAP.title: Note limit reached
NOTE_CAP.when: The pass already holds the maximum number of notes.
NOTE_CAP.fix: Delete an old note before adding another.

NOTE_DEVICE_CAP.title: Device note limit reached
NOTE_DEVICE_CAP.when: This device has added its daily limit of notes to this person.
NOTE_DEVICE_CAP.fix: Add the note from another device or wait until tomorrow.

NOTE_HELD.title: Pass on hold
NOTE_HELD.when: A retention or legal hold covers the pass, so its notes cannot be edited or deleted.
NOTE_HELD.fix: Ask an org admin to release the hold. Adding a note still works.

NOTE_NOT_FOUND.title: Note not found
NOTE_NOT_FOUND.when: No note with this id exists on the pass.

NOTE_ROLE.title: Note role not allowed
NOTE_ROLE.when: Reading or adding notes needs Desk staff, and changing one needs its author or a manager.
NOTE_ROLE.fix: Sign in as Desk staff or a manager with the staff PIN.

NOT_A_CAPTURE_ENDPOINT.title: Not a capture endpoint
NOT_A_CAPTURE_ENDPOINT.when: You read captures of an endpoint that sends to a URL.
NOT_A_CAPTURE_ENDPOINT.fix: Use a capture endpoint: POST /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/capture returns your sandbox's.

NOT_A_ZIP.title: Not a zip file
NOT_A_ZIP.when: The uploaded file is not a zip archive.
NOT_A_ZIP.fix: Upload the template as a .zip file.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.when: The id does not exist in your organization and mode.
NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, and that the key's mode (test or live) matches the object.

NOT_INSIDE.title: Not inside
NOT_INSIDE.when: The person is already marked out.
NOT_INSIDE.fix: Do nothing; check occupancy before marking out.

NO_FILE.title: No file attached
NO_FILE.when: The request has no file field.
NO_FILE.fix: Send the archive as multipart form data in the file field.

NO_RECIPIENT.title: No recipient
NO_RECIPIENT.when: The pass has no holder email to send to.
NO_RECIPIENT.fix: Set the holder's email with PATCH /api/v1/passes/{id}, then send again.

NO_VERIFIED_EMAIL.title: No verified email
NO_VERIFIED_EMAIL.when: The user has no verified email address to send the test to.
NO_VERIFIED_EMAIL.fix: Verify an email address on the account, then send again.

OFFLINE_OFF.title: Offline scanning off
OFFLINE_OFF.when: The session does not use an offline list or take offline scans.
OFFLINE_OFF.fix: Turn on offline scanning for the session, or scan online.

OFFLINE_TOO_BIG.title: Offline list too large
OFFLINE_TOO_BIG.when: The session covers more passes than an offline list can hold.
OFFLINE_TOO_BIG.fix: Narrow the session to fewer events or pass types.

OIDC_REQUIRED.title: Polaris ID sign-in required
OIDC_REQUIRED.when: This action needs a session signed in with Polaris ID.
OIDC_REQUIRED.fix: Sign in with Polaris ID, then send the request again.

OPERATION_NOT_CANCELABLE.title: Operation cannot be stopped
OPERATION_NOT_CANCELABLE.when: The operation's kind cannot be stopped, or it has ended.
OPERATION_NOT_CANCELABLE.fix: Wait for it to finish. Read it with GET /api/v1/operations/{id}.

OPERATION_NOT_FOUND.title: Operation not found
OPERATION_NOT_FOUND.when: The id is unknown, or the caller may not read that operation.
OPERATION_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id. List your operations with GET /api/v1/operations.

OPERATION_NOT_RETRYABLE.title: Operation cannot be retried
OPERATION_NOT_RETRYABLE.when: The operation has not failed, or its failure cannot be retried. A run id that does not name a repeatable run is 404.
OPERATION_NOT_RETRYABLE.fix: Read it with GET /api/v1/operations/{id}. Start the action again instead.

OPERATION_RUNNING.title: Already running
OPERATION_RUNNING.when: An operation for the same subject is still active. The response names it in operationId.
OPERATION_RUNNING.fix: Follow the operation named in operationId instead of starting another.

ORG_ACCESS_CHANGED.title: Organization access changed
ORG_ACCESS_CHANGED.when: The caller's membership or key access changed while the request ran.
ORG_ACCESS_CHANGED.fix: Check access with GET /api/v1/api-keys/me, then send the request again.

ORG_CONFLICT.title: Organization changed
ORG_CONFLICT.when: Another request changed the organization while yours ran.
ORG_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/orgs/{id} and send the change again.

ORG_FORBIDDEN.title: Organization not accessible
ORG_FORBIDDEN.when: The key or scanner cannot access this organization, or a platform-wide list needs a platform key.
ORG_FORBIDDEN.fix: Use a key scoped to this organization, or a platform key for platform-wide lists.

ORG_INACTIVE.title: Organization inactive
ORG_INACTIVE.when: The organization is suspended or closed.
ORG_INACTIVE.fix: Reactivate it with POST /api/v1/orgs/{orgId}/reopen or ask the platform owner.

ORG_MIXED.title: Passes from several organizations
ORG_MIXED.when: The ids belong to more than one organization.
ORG_MIXED.fix: Send ids from one organization per request.

ORG_NOT_FOUND.title: Organization not found
ORG_NOT_FOUND.when: No organization with this id exists.

ORG_PERSONAL.title: Personal organization
ORG_PERSONAL.when: A platform admin other than the owner used a platform action on a personal organization: its directory page, plan, features, status, close or reopen.
ORG_PERSONAL.fix: A personal organization is managed by its owner. Use a regular organization.

ORG_PERSONAL_SINGLE_MEMBER.title: Personal organization has one member
ORG_PERSONAL_SINGLE_MEMBER.when: You invited a member to, or revoked the owner of, a personal organization.
ORG_PERSONAL_SINGLE_MEMBER.fix: Use a regular organization to work with others.

ORG_REQUIRED.title: Organization required
ORG_REQUIRED.when: The request spans organizations and does not name one.
ORG_REQUIRED.fix: Send orgId with the request, or use a key scoped to one organization.

ORG_SLUG_RESERVED.title: Slug reserved
ORG_SLUG_RESERVED.when: The slug starts with personal-, which belongs to personal organizations.

ORG_SLUG_TAKEN.title: Slug taken
ORG_SLUG_TAKEN.when: Another organization already uses this slug.

ORG_STATUS_ALONE.title: Status change must be alone
ORG_STATUS_ALONE.when: The update changes the status and other fields together.
ORG_STATUS_ALONE.fix: Send the status change in its own request, then the other edits.

PAIRING_INVALID.title: Pairing code invalid
PAIRING_INVALID.when: The pairing code is wrong, used or expired.
PAIRING_INVALID.fix: Create a new pairing code and enter it again.

PASSKEY_REQUIRED.title: Passkey required
PASSKEY_REQUIRED.when: A Polaris ID sign-in finished with an emailed login code instead of a passkey, twice.
PASSKEY_REQUIRED.fix: Sign in to Polaris ID with your passkey, not a code.

PASS_CONFLICT.title: Pass changed
PASS_CONFLICT.when: The pass changed or lost its owner while the request ran.
PASS_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch the pass with GET /api/v1/passes/{id} and send the request again.

PASS_CONNECTION_MISMATCH.title: Pass not linked to this connection
PASS_CONNECTION_MISMATCH.when: The pass is not linked to the connection, or its connection is incomplete.
PASS_CONNECTION_MISMATCH.fix: Link it with PUT /api/v1/passes/{id}/connection, then send the request again.

PASS_FILE_MISSING.title: Pass file missing
PASS_FILE_MISSING.when: The stored pass file is not available.

PASS_INPUT_INVALID.title: Pass input invalid
PASS_INPUT_INVALID.when: The inputs do not match the template's input schema.
PASS_INPUT_INVALID.fix: Fix the inputs named in issues; GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema lists them.

PASS_INVALID.title: Pass invalid
PASS_INVALID.when: The built pass fails pass-format validation.
PASS_INVALID.fix: Fix the problems named in issues in the template or inputs.

PASS_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Pass not active
PASS_NOT_ACTIVE.when: The action needs an active pass, and this one is voided, expired or removed.
PASS_NOT_ACTIVE.fix: Restore or unvoid the pass first, or use an active one.

PASS_NOT_FOUND.title: Pass not found
PASS_NOT_FOUND.when: No pass with this id exists in this mode and organization.
PASS_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id with GET /api/v1/passes and the key's mode.

PASS_REF_TAKEN.title: Connection ref in use
PASS_REF_TAKEN.when: Another pass already uses this connection ref.
PASS_REF_TAKEN.fix: Use a different ref, or update the existing pass.

PASS_REISSUE_REQUIRED.title: Reissue required
PASS_REISSUE_REQUIRED.when: The pass's scanner credential was retired and cannot be reused.

PASS_REMOVED.title: Pass removed
PASS_REMOVED.when: The pass was removed from the holder's wallet.
PASS_REMOVED.fix: Restore it with POST /api/v1/passes/{id}/restore, then send the request again.

PASS_SETUP_CHANGED.title: Setup changed
PASS_SETUP_CHANGED.when: Another request changed the organization's setup, or its wallet account, after your read.
PASS_SETUP_CHANGED.fix: Fetch it again with GET /api/v1/orgs/{orgId}/pass-setup and send your change with the new revision.

PASS_SETUP_EMPTY.title: Nothing to change
PASS_SETUP_EMPTY.when: The pass-setup change has no brand or channels entry.
PASS_SETUP_EMPTY.fix: Send at least one field in brand or channels.

PASS_TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND.title: Pass transfer not found
PASS_TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND.when: No transfer with this id exists for the pass.

PASS_TRANSFER_PENDING.title: Pass transfer pending
PASS_TRANSFER_PENDING.when: This pass is being transferred while its existing wallet credentials are retired.

PHOTO_PASS_INACTIVE.title: Pass not active
PHOTO_PASS_INACTIVE.when: A photo cannot be added to an inactive pass.

PHOTO_ROLE.title: Photo role not allowed
PHOTO_ROLE.when: Only Desk staff can add photos.
PHOTO_ROLE.fix: Sign in as Desk staff with the staff PIN.

PIN_GENERATION_FAILED.title: PIN not generated
PIN_GENERATION_FAILED.when: The server could not generate a new unique PIN.

PIN_INVALID.title: PIN wrong
PIN_INVALID.when: The PIN does not match any staff member.
PIN_INVALID.fix: Enter the correct PIN; repeated misses lock the entry for a while.

PIN_ALONE_NOT_SELF.title: Approve your own request
PIN_ALONE_NOT_SELF.when: An approval with alone: true named someone other than the signed-in staff member.
PIN_ALONE_NOT_SELF.fix: Send your own staff id, or drop alone and ask another approver.

PIN_MANAGER_REQUIRED.title: Manager required
PIN_MANAGER_REQUIRED.when: The action needs a manager and none was chosen.
PIN_MANAGER_REQUIRED.fix: Name a manager in the request.

PRINTING_OFF.title: Printing is off
PRINTING_OFF.when: Printing is turned off for this template or organization.
PRINTING_OFF.fix: Turn printing on in Admin, then send the request again.

PRINT_CODE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Print code unavailable
PRINT_CODE_UNAVAILABLE.when: The pass has no code that can be printed.
PRINT_CODE_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Rebuild the pass, then print it again.

PRINT_CONFLICT.title: Print conflict
PRINT_CONFLICT.when: The print job conflicts with one already queued.
PRINT_CONFLICT.fix: Wait for the current job to finish, then send the request again.

PRINT_JOB_NOT_FOUND.title: Print job not found
PRINT_JOB_NOT_FOUND.when: No print job has this id in your organization.
PRINT_JOB_NOT_FOUND.fix: List the print jobs and use an id from the list.

PRINT_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Print not active
PRINT_NOT_ACTIVE.when: The print job is no longer active.

PRINT_NOT_FOUND.title: Print not found
PRINT_NOT_FOUND.when: No print has this id in your organization.
PRINT_NOT_FOUND.fix: List the prints and use an id from the list.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Rate limited
RATE_LIMITED.when: The key went over its request limit.
RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait for Retry-After seconds, then retry. Back off on repeats.

RECIPIENT_NOT_HOLDER.title: Recipient is not the holder
RECIPIENT_NOT_HOLDER.when: The email is not the holder's address on the pass or bundle.
RECIPIENT_NOT_HOLDER.fix: Send to the holder's email, or change it with PATCH /api/v1/passes/{id}.

REPLAY_NOT_QUEUED.title: Replay not queued
REPLAY_NOT_QUEUED.when: The queue was unavailable, so no deliveries were queued.

REPLAY_TOO_LARGE.title: Replay range too large
REPLAY_TOO_LARGE.when: The replay range holds more deliveries than one replay allows.
REPLAY_TOO_LARGE.fix: Narrow the time range or replay in several smaller requests.

REPLY_TO_LINK_INVALID.title: Reply-to link invalid
REPLY_TO_LINK_INVALID.when: The confirmation link is wrong, used or expired.
REPLY_TO_LINK_INVALID.fix: Request a new link with POST /api/v1/settings/reply-to/resend.

REPLY_TO_NOTHING_PENDING.title: No reply-to to confirm
REPLY_TO_NOTHING_PENDING.when: No reply-to address is waiting for confirmation.
REPLY_TO_NOTHING_PENDING.fix: Set a new reply-to address with PUT /api/v1/settings first.

REPLY_TO_RESEND_LIMITED.title: Reply-to resend limited
REPLY_TO_RESEND_LIMITED.when: A confirmation link was sent less than a minute ago.
REPLY_TO_RESEND_LIMITED.fix: Wait a minute, then call POST /api/v1/settings/reply-to/resend again.

RETENTION_CHANGED.title: Retention changed
RETENTION_CHANGED.when: The retention policy changed while the request ran.
RETENTION_CHANGED.fix: Read the current policy and send the request again.

RETENTION_RECEIPT_BUSY.title: Retention receipt busy
RETENTION_RECEIPT_BUSY.when: Another retention job is writing the organization's receipt chain.
RETENTION_RECEIPT_BUSY.fix: Wait a few seconds and send the request again.

ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Scanner role not allowed
ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.when: This device cannot change its role.
ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Change the role from the scanner's setup in the admin console.

ROLL_CALL_ENDED.title: Roll call ended
ROLL_CALL_ENDED.when: The roll call is closed and takes no more marks.

ROLL_CALL_NOT_FOUND.title: Roll call not found
ROLL_CALL_NOT_FOUND.when: No roll call with this id exists for this scanner.

ROLL_CALL_NO_PLACES.title: Nothing tracked
ROLL_CALL_NO_PLACES.when: The scanner's session tracks no place, so there is no one to call.
ROLL_CALL_NO_PLACES.fix: Turn on occupancy tracking for the session, then start the roll call.

ROLL_CALL_NO_SESSION.title: Scanner not in a session
ROLL_CALL_NO_SESSION.when: The scanner is not assigned to a scanning session.
ROLL_CALL_NO_SESSION.fix: Assign the scanner to a session in the admin console, then start the roll call.

ROLL_CALL_TOO_LARGE.title: Too many people inside
ROLL_CALL_TOO_LARGE.when: More people are inside than a roll call list can hold.
ROLL_CALL_TOO_LARGE.fix: Mark people out in bulk before starting the roll call.

RULE_HOURS_NEED_DATETIME.title: Quiet hours need a date and time
RULE_HOURS_NEED_DATETIME.when: The rule uses hours but its date input is a date without a time.
RULE_HOURS_NEED_DATETIME.fix: Use a date-and-time input for the rule, or remove the hours.

RULE_INPUT_MISMATCH.title: Rule inputs differ across templates
RULE_INPUT_MISMATCH.when: The rule's date input is a date on one template and a date and time on another.
RULE_INPUT_MISMATCH.fix: Pick templates where the input has the same type.

RULE_INPUT_MISSING.title: Rule input missing
RULE_INPUT_MISSING.when: A template in the rule has no input with the name the rule uses.
RULE_INPUT_MISSING.fix: Use an input name from GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema for every template.

RULE_LIMIT.title: Automatic message limit reached
RULE_LIMIT.when: The organization already has the maximum number of automatic messages on.
RULE_LIMIT.fix: Pause one with POST /api/v1/message-rules/{id}/pause, then turn this one on.

RULE_NOT_FOUND.title: Automatic message not found
RULE_NOT_FOUND.when: No rule with this id exists in this mode and organization.

RULE_VERSION.title: Rule changed
RULE_VERSION.when: Someone changed the rule after you loaded it.
RULE_VERSION.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/message-rules/{id} and send your change again.

SAMPLE_EVENT_LIVE.title: Sample events are Test only
SAMPLE_EVENT_LIVE.when: You sent a sample event of a type other than webhook.test to a Live endpoint.
SAMPLE_EVENT_LIVE.fix: Send it to a Test endpoint, or send webhook.test.

SAMPLE_TEST_ONLY.title: Sample passes are test-only
SAMPLE_TEST_ONLY.when: A sample pass was requested from a live scanner.
SAMPLE_TEST_ONLY.fix: Request sample passes from a test-mode scanner.

SAMSUNG_FIELDS_INVALID.title: Samsung fields invalid
SAMSUNG_FIELDS_INVALID.when: The Samsung Wallet callback has missing or malformed fields.
SAMSUNG_FIELDS_INVALID.fix: Send callbacks only from Samsung Wallet; check the callback setup.

SAMSUNG_UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Samsung authorization invalid
SAMSUNG_UNAUTHENTICATED.when: The Samsung Wallet callback's authorization did not verify.
SAMSUNG_UNAUTHENTICATED.fix: Check the Samsung Wallet partner credentials stored for the organization.

SAMSUNG_UNAVAILABLE.title: Samsung service unavailable
SAMSUNG_UNAVAILABLE.when: The Samsung Wallet service is unreachable.

SANDBOX_PREVIEW_ONLY.title: Preview only
SANDBOX_PREVIEW_ONLY.when: A sandbox pass was asked to install in Wallet.
SANDBOX_PREVIEW_ONLY.fix: Use the preview card and QR in the console; live passes need a real organization.

SANDBOX_QUOTA.title: Sandbox quota reached
SANDBOX_QUOTA.when: A developer sandbox hit its cap on passes, templates or webhook endpoints.
SANDBOX_QUOTA.fix: Delete test objects you no longer need, or move to an organization with live access.

SCANNER_ADMIN_ROLE.title: Admin setup needs a browser device
SCANNER_ADMIN_ROLE.when: An admin setup was given a non-browser device role.
SCANNER_ADMIN_ROLE.fix: Use a browser device for admin sign-in.

SCANNER_ADMIN_SETUP_EXISTS.title: Admin setup exists
SCANNER_ADMIN_SETUP_EXISTS.when: The admin already has a scanner setup in that mode.

SCANNER_ADMIN_USER.title: Admin setup owner
SCANNER_ADMIN_USER.when: An admin setup belongs to the admin who creates it.
SCANNER_ADMIN_USER.fix: Create it signed in as that admin, and leave out another user.

SCANNER_CANNOT_SCAN.title: Device cannot scan
SCANNER_CANNOT_SCAN.when: The device is not a scanning device, so it cannot take an event.
SCANNER_CANNOT_SCAN.fix: Assign events only to scanning devices.

SCANNER_CHANGED.title: Scanner changed
SCANNER_CHANGED.when: Another request changed this scanner while yours ran.
SCANNER_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the scanner and send your change again.

SCANNER_EXPIRED.title: Scanner pairing expired
SCANNER_EXPIRED.when: The scanner's pairing is no longer valid.

SCANNER_NAME_TAKEN.title: Scanner name taken
SCANNER_NAME_TAKEN.when: Another scanner already has this name.

SCANNER_NOT_FOUND.title: Scanner not found
SCANNER_NOT_FOUND.when: No scanner with this id exists in this mode and organization.
SCANNER_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the scanner id and the key's mode.

SCANNER_NOT_PAIRABLE.title: Scanner cannot pair with a code
SCANNER_NOT_PAIRABLE.when: Only browser devices pair with a code.
SCANNER_NOT_PAIRABLE.fix: Use the pairing method for this device type.

SCANNER_NOT_TERMINAL.title: Scanner is not a till
SCANNER_NOT_TERMINAL.fix: Create a token only for a till scanner.

SCANNER_NO_TAGS.title: Scanner cannot read tags
SCANNER_NO_TAGS.when: The scanner is not set up to read NFC tags.
SCANNER_NO_TAGS.fix: Pick a scanner with tag reading on.

SCANNER_OFFLINE.title: Scanner offline
SCANNER_OFFLINE.when: The scanner is not connected, so it cannot take the tag request.
SCANNER_OFFLINE.fix: Open the scanner app, then send the request again.

SCANNER_REPAIR.title: Scanner must pair again
SCANNER_REPAIR.when: The scanner's credential no longer verifies.
SCANNER_REPAIR.fix: Pair the scanner again with a new code.

SCANNER_REQUESTS_OFF.title: Tag requests off
SCANNER_REQUESTS_OFF.when: The scanner does not take tag requests.
SCANNER_REQUESTS_OFF.fix: Turn on tag requests for the scanner, or pick another.

SCANNER_REVOKED.title: Scanner revoked
SCANNER_REVOKED.when: The scanner was removed from the organization.

SCANNER_ROLE_INVALID.title: Scanner role invalid
SCANNER_ROLE_INVALID.when: The role is not supported by this device type.
SCANNER_ROLE_INVALID.fix: Choose a role the device supports.

SCANNER_SETUP_EXISTS.title: Scanner setup exists
SCANNER_SETUP_EXISTS.when: A setup with this name or admin already exists.
SCANNER_SETUP_EXISTS.fix: Use the existing setup or give the new one another name.

SCANNER_UNASSIGNED.title: Scanner has no assignment
SCANNER_UNASSIGNED.when: The scanner does not yet accept any events or pass types.
SCANNER_UNASSIGNED.fix: Choose what it accepts, then send the request again.

SCANNER_UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Scanner not paired
SCANNER_UNAUTHENTICATED.when: The request has no valid scanner session.
SCANNER_UNAUTHENTICATED.fix: Pair the scanner, then sign in with the staff PIN.

SCANNER_WATCH_INVALID.title: Watch list invalid
SCANNER_WATCH_INVALID.when: The screen's watch list names no valid scanners or sessions.
SCANNER_WATCH_INVALID.fix: Choose at least one scanner or session to follow.

SCANNER_WATCH_MODE.title: Watch list mixes modes
SCANNER_WATCH_MODE.when: The watched scanners, sessions and event are not all in the screen's mode.
SCANNER_WATCH_MODE.fix: Move them to the same mode, or choose others.

SCANNER_WATCH_NOT_FOUND.title: Watched item not found
SCANNER_WATCH_NOT_FOUND.when: A scanner, session or event in the watch list no longer exists.
SCANNER_WATCH_NOT_FOUND.fix: Remove it from the watch list.

SCANNING_DEVICE_CHANGED.title: Scanning device changed
SCANNING_DEVICE_CHANGED.when: Another request changed this device while yours ran.
SCANNING_DEVICE_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the device and send your change again.

SCANNING_FOLLOWS_INVALID.title: Scanners to follow not allowed
SCANNING_FOLLOWS_INVALID.when: A customer screen was given a scanner that is not a live scanner of its session, or its stored scanners no longer parse.
SCANNING_FOLLOWS_INVALID.fix: Pick live scanners from the same session, after the session exists.

SCANNING_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.title: Scanning device not found
SCANNING_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.when: No device with this id exists in this mode and organization.

SCANNING_HOLD_RANGE.title: Hold duration out of range
SCANNING_HOLD_RANGE.when: The open-for duration is longer than 24 hours.
SCANNING_HOLD_RANGE.fix: Open scanning for at most 24 hours.

SCANNING_HOURS_NONE.title: No scanning hours ahead
SCANNING_HOURS_NONE.when: The session has no scheduled opening in the next 8 days.
SCANNING_HOURS_NONE.fix: Pause the session instead, or add scanning hours.

SCANNING_SESSION_CHANGED.title: Scanning session changed
SCANNING_SESSION_CHANGED.when: Another request changed this session while yours ran.
SCANNING_SESSION_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the session and send your change again.

SCANNING_SESSION_CLOSED.title: Scanning closed
SCANNING_SESSION_CLOSED.when: The session is outside its scanning hours, or is already closed.
SCANNING_SESSION_CLOSED.fix: Wait for the next opening, or open it for a while.

SCANNING_SESSION_CONFIG_REQUIRED.title: Configure from the session
SCANNING_SESSION_CONFIG_REQUIRED.when: The device takes its settings from its scanning session.
SCANNING_SESSION_CONFIG_REQUIRED.fix: Change the settings on the session, not on the device.

SCANNING_SESSION_COUNTS_UNAVAILABLE.title: Session counts unavailable
SCANNING_SESSION_COUNTS_UNAVAILABLE.when: The session's counts could not be read.

SCANNING_SESSION_MODE.title: Session in another mode
SCANNING_SESSION_MODE.when: The device is open in a mode that differs from its session's.
SCANNING_SESSION_MODE.fix: Open the device in the session's mode.

SCANNING_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.title: Scanning session not found
SCANNING_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.when: No session with this id exists in this mode and organization.

SCANNING_SESSION_OPEN.title: Scanning already open
SCANNING_SESSION_OPEN.fix: Do nothing; close it first to change how long it stays open.

SCANNING_SESSION_PAUSED.title: Scanning paused
SCANNING_SESSION_PAUSED.when: The session is paused, so it takes no scans.
SCANNING_SESSION_PAUSED.fix: Resume the session, then scan again.

SCANNING_SESSION_REMOVE_DEVICES.title: Devices stay
SCANNING_SESSION_REMOVE_DEVICES.when: removeDevices was sent without ending the session.
SCANNING_SESSION_REMOVE_DEVICES.fix: Set status to ended, or leave removeDevices out.

SCANNING_SESSION_SCOPE_INVALID.title: Session scope invalid
SCANNING_SESSION_SCOPE_INVALID.when: The session's scope or settings are invalid, so devices cannot be added.
SCANNING_SESSION_SCOPE_INVALID.fix: Correct the session's scope and settings, then add the device.

SCANNING_SESSION_SETTINGS_INVALID.title: Session settings invalid
SCANNING_SESSION_SETTINGS_INVALID.when: The session's settings are invalid, so devices cannot open it.
SCANNING_SESSION_SETTINGS_INVALID.fix: Correct the session's settings, then retry.

SCAN_ACCESS_CHANGED.title: Scan access changed
SCAN_ACCESS_CHANGED.when: The caller's access changed while the request ran.
SCAN_ACCESS_CHANGED.fix: Reload the session and send the request again.

SCAN_ADMIN_SETUP_REQUIRED.title: Admin scanner setup required
SCAN_ADMIN_SETUP_REQUIRED.when: An admin must choose their admin scanner setup before scanning.
SCAN_ADMIN_SETUP_REQUIRED.fix: Choose the admin setup in the console, then retry.

SCAN_BODY_INVALID.title: Scan body invalid
SCAN_BODY_INVALID.when: The request body is not valid JSON.
SCAN_BODY_INVALID.fix: Send a JSON body with Content-Type: application/json.

SCAN_CONFIG_CHANGED.title: Scan configuration changed
SCAN_CONFIG_CHANGED.when: The scanning configuration changed between scan and save.
SCAN_CONFIG_CHANGED.fix: Reload the scanner and scan again.

SCAN_COUNTS_UNAVAILABLE.title: Scan counts unavailable
SCAN_COUNTS_UNAVAILABLE.when: The scan counts could not be read.

SCAN_CREDENTIAL_CHANGED.title: Scanner credential changed
SCAN_CREDENTIAL_CHANGED.when: The scanner's credential was rotated while its live connection was open.
SCAN_CREDENTIAL_CHANGED.fix: Reconnect the scanner so it picks up the new credential.

SCAN_DISPLAY_PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND.title: Display preview not found
SCAN_DISPLAY_PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND.when: No scan display preview exists for this id.
SCAN_DISPLAY_PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND.fix: Create the preview again and use its new id.

SCAN_DRAFT_INVALID.title: Draft not allowed
SCAN_DRAFT_INVALID.when: A draft shows only a money take or add that this desk may run, within the action's limit.
SCAN_DRAFT_INVALID.fix: Use a money action and an amount within its limit.

SCAN_DRAFT_STALE.title: Read is over
SCAN_DRAFT_STALE.when: The scanner has no presented read under a minute old, or its pass changed.

SCAN_EVENT_CHANGED.title: Scan event changed
SCAN_EVENT_CHANGED.when: The event's templates or release changed while your request ran.
SCAN_EVENT_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the event with GET /api/v1/scan/events and send your change again.

SCAN_EVENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Event not found
SCAN_EVENT_NOT_FOUND.when: No scan event with this id exists in this mode and organization.
SCAN_EVENT_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the event id with GET /api/v1/scan/events.

SCAN_EXPORT_RANGE.title: Export range too long
SCAN_EXPORT_RANGE.when: The export covers more than 92 days.
SCAN_EXPORT_RANGE.fix: Export up to 92 days per request.

SCAN_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.title: Export too large
SCAN_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.when: The export holds more than 100,000 scans.
SCAN_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.fix: Narrow the date range or filters and export in parts.

SCAN_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE.title: Scan history unavailable
SCAN_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE.when: The scan history could not be read.

SCAN_IN_PROGRESS.title: Scan still recording
SCAN_IN_PROGRESS.when: An earlier request with this key is still being recorded.
SCAN_IN_PROGRESS.fix: Wait a moment and resend the identical request.

SCAN_KEY_REUSED.title: Request key reused
SCAN_KEY_REUSED.when: This request key was already used for a different scan action.
SCAN_KEY_REUSED.fix: Use a new unique request key for each action.

SCAN_LIVE_ORIGIN.title: Live screen on wrong origin
SCAN_LIVE_ORIGIN.when: The live scan screen was opened from another site.
SCAN_LIVE_ORIGIN.fix: Open the screen on the PassBook site.

SCAN_LOOKUP_DISABLED.title: Lookup disabled
SCAN_LOOKUP_DISABLED.when: Lookup is turned off for this scanner.
SCAN_LOOKUP_DISABLED.fix: Turn on lookup in the scanner's settings.

SCAN_MARK_OUT_INVALID.title: Cannot mark out
SCAN_MARK_OUT_INVALID.when: The person cannot be marked out, for example they are not inside.
SCAN_MARK_OUT_INVALID.fix: Check who is inside, then mark out someone who is.

SCAN_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Scan mode mismatch
SCAN_MODE_MISMATCH.when: The scan, scanner or event is in a different mode (test or live).
SCAN_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Use a key and objects of the same mode.

SCAN_NOT_FOUND.title: Scan not found
SCAN_NOT_FOUND.when: No scan with this id exists for this scanner, or it cannot be undone from here.
SCAN_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the scan id and the scanner's mode.

SCAN_NO_SESSION.title: Scanner not in a session
SCAN_NO_SESSION.when: The scanner is not assigned to a scanning session.
SCAN_NO_SESSION.fix: Assign the scanner to a session in the admin console.

SCAN_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN.title: Override not allowed
SCAN_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN.when: This refusal cannot be overridden, such as a full event.
SCAN_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN.fix: Do not retry; no one can let this person in.

SCAN_OVERRIDE_INVALID.title: Override not valid
SCAN_OVERRIDE_INVALID.when: This scan cannot be let through.
SCAN_OVERRIDE_INVALID.fix: Override only scans that were refused for an overridable reason.

SCAN_OVERRIDE_NOTE_CLOSED.title: Override note closed
