SCAN_OVERRIDE_NOTE_CLOSED.when: The override's note can no longer be added.
SCAN_OVERRIDE_NOTE_CLOSED.fix: Add the note when you override, not afterwards.

SCAN_OVERRIDE_TAKEN.title: Already overridden
SCAN_OVERRIDE_TAKEN.when: Someone else already let this person in.
SCAN_OVERRIDE_TAKEN.fix: Do nothing; check the scan's history.

SCAN_PASS_CHANGED.title: Pass changed during scan
SCAN_PASS_CHANGED.when: The pass changed between reading and recording the scan.

SCAN_SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Scan scope not allowed
SCAN_SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED.when: A scanner sent a scope it is not allowed to choose.
SCAN_SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Leave out the scope; a paired scanner uses its own.

SCAN_SCOPE_REQUIRED.title: Scan scope required
SCAN_SCOPE_REQUIRED.when: The request does not say which organization to scan for.
SCAN_SCOPE_REQUIRED.fix: Send orgId, or use a key scoped to one organization.

SCAN_SEARCH_FORBIDDEN.title: Name search not allowed
SCAN_SEARCH_FORBIDDEN.when: Searching by pass name needs an administrator.
SCAN_SEARCH_FORBIDDEN.fix: Search by pass id or code, or sign in as an administrator.

SCAN_SETTINGS_INVALID.title: Scanner settings invalid
SCAN_SETTINGS_INVALID.when: The scanner's saved settings fail validation.
SCAN_SETTINGS_INVALID.fix: Correct the settings named in issues, then retry.

SCAN_SETUP_ADMIN_SCOPE.title: Staff need scanning:admin
SCAN_SETUP_ADMIN_SCOPE.when: A key without scanning:admin named new staff.
SCAN_SETUP_ADMIN_SCOPE.fix: Use a scanning:admin key, or leave staff out.

SCAN_SETUP_CHANGED.title: Setup changed
SCAN_SETUP_CHANGED.when: Something the setup relies on changed while it ran. Nothing was written.

SCAN_SETUP_CHECKS_FAILED.title: Setup has problems
SCAN_SETUP_CHECKS_FAILED.when: A check with level error stops the setup.
SCAN_SETUP_CHECKS_FAILED.fix: Fix what the issues name, then send it again.

SCAN_SETUP_CONFLICT.title: Template already scanned
SCAN_SETUP_CONFLICT.when: Another session already scans this template.
SCAN_SETUP_CONFLICT.fix: Remove the template from the other session, or reuse that session.

SCAN_SETUP_INVALID.title: Setup needs changes
SCAN_SETUP_INVALID.when: The setup names something that does not exist or breaks a rule.
SCAN_SETUP_INVALID.fix: Fix the paths in issues, then send it again.

SCAN_SETUP_KEY_REQUIRED.title: Idempotency-Key missing
SCAN_SETUP_KEY_REQUIRED.when: A setup that writes needs an Idempotency-Key header.
SCAN_SETUP_KEY_REQUIRED.fix: Send one, or add dryRun=true to only see the plan.

SCAN_SETUP_KEY_REUSED.title: Key used for another setup
SCAN_SETUP_KEY_REUSED.when: This Idempotency-Key went with a different body.
SCAN_SETUP_KEY_REUSED.fix: Use a new key for a different setup.

SCAN_MODE_LIVE_ONLY.title: Live key needed
SCAN_MODE_LIVE_ONLY.when: Moving a scanner between live and test changes its mode for everyone, so a test key cannot do it.

SCAN_SETUP_LIVE_ONLY.title: Live key needed
SCAN_SETUP_LIVE_ONLY.when: Places and staff are shared with live mode, so a test key cannot make them.

SCAN_SETUP_NAME_TAKEN.title: Name taken meanwhile
SCAN_SETUP_NAME_TAKEN.when: A name or key was taken while the setup ran. Nothing was written.

SCAN_STAFF_CHANGED.title: Staff changed
SCAN_STAFF_CHANGED.when: The staff member or their settings changed while the request ran.
SCAN_STAFF_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the staff list and send the request again.

SCAN_STAFF_CURSOR.title: Staff cursor invalid
SCAN_STAFF_CURSOR.when: The cursor is no longer valid for the staff list.
SCAN_STAFF_CURSOR.fix: Drop the cursor and list again from the start.

SCAN_STAFF_NOT_FOUND.title: Staff member not found
SCAN_STAFF_NOT_FOUND.when: No staff member with this id exists.
SCAN_STAFF_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id with the scanner's staff list.

SCAN_SUMMARY_SESSION_FORBIDDEN.title: Session totals need a manager
SCAN_SUMMARY_SESSION_FORBIDDEN.when: Only Managers can read session totals.
SCAN_SUMMARY_SESSION_FORBIDDEN.fix: Sign in with a manager PIN.

SCAN_SURFACE_UNSUPPORTED.title: Surface not supported
SCAN_SURFACE_UNSUPPORTED.when: A terminal cannot be used as a display.
SCAN_SURFACE_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Use a screen device for displays.

SCAN_TOO_MANY_MISSES.title: Too many unknown codes
SCAN_TOO_MANY_MISSES.when: The scanner read too many codes that match no pass.
SCAN_TOO_MANY_MISSES.fix: Wait a few minutes, then scan again.

SCAN_TOO_MANY_OVERRIDES.title: Too many overrides
SCAN_TOO_MANY_OVERRIDES.when: The scanner reached its override limit for this hour.
SCAN_TOO_MANY_OVERRIDES.fix: Wait for the next hour, or ask a manager.

SCAN_UNDO_EXPIRED.title: Undo window passed
SCAN_UNDO_EXPIRED.when: The scan is too old to undo.
SCAN_UNDO_EXPIRED.fix: Correct the record by other means, such as marking the person out.

SCAN_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.title: Undo not allowed
SCAN_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.when: This operator cannot undo this scan.
SCAN_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.fix: Ask a manager, or the operator who made the scan, to undo it.

SCAN_WINDOW_INVALID.title: Scan window invalid
SCAN_WINDOW_INVALID.when: The scan window ends before it starts, counting dates inherited from the template.
SCAN_WINDOW_INVALID.fix: Set an end after the start, or fix the template's dates.

SCREEN_ONLY.title: Device is a screen
SCREEN_ONLY.when: A screen device tried to scan or act.
SCREEN_ONLY.fix: Use a scanner device for scanning.

SCREEN_REQUIRED.title: Screen view required
SCREEN_REQUIRED.when: A live connection needs a device set to a screen view.
SCREEN_REQUIRED.fix: Choose a screen view for the device in Scanning.

SECRET_UNAVAILABLE.title: Signing secret unavailable
SECRET_UNAVAILABLE.when: The endpoint has no signing secret that can be read.
SECRET_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Rotate the secret with POST /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/secret, then send the request again.

SELECTION_CHANGED.title: Selection changed
SELECTION_CHANGED.when: The passes the request matches now differ from expectCount. A change run allows 2%, because it starts a moment after it is made; a bulk run allows none.
SELECTION_CHANGED.fix: Check the new count, then send it as expectCount.

SERIAL_TAKEN.title: Serial in use
SERIAL_TAKEN.when: Another pass already has this serial.
SERIAL_TAKEN.fix: Send a different serial, or leave it out to have one generated.

SESSION_OPEN_FORBIDDEN.title: Manager must open
SESSION_OPEN_FORBIDDEN.when: Only a manager can open this session.
SESSION_OPEN_FORBIDDEN.fix: Sign in with a manager PIN, then open it.

SESSION_REQUIRED.title: Signed-in user required
SESSION_REQUIRED.when: The action needs a signed-in user, not an API key.
SESSION_REQUIRED.fix: Do it in the console, or sign in as the account that started it.

SETTINGS_CHANGED.title: Settings changed
SETTINGS_CHANGED.when: Another request changed the settings while yours ran.
SETTINGS_CHANGED.fix: Fetch them with GET /api/v1/settings and send your change again.

STAFF_NAME_REQUIRED.title: Name required
STAFF_NAME_REQUIRED.when: Sign-in with a PIN alone is not available now: it is off for the org, paused after too many wrong PINs, or the org has more than 100 active staff.

STAFF_NAME_TAKEN.title: Staff name taken
STAFF_NAME_TAKEN.when: Another active staff member already has this name.

STAFF_PIN_ADMIN_RESET.title: Admin reset needed
STAFF_PIN_ADMIN_RESET.when: A Manager whose PIN is shared asked for a new PIN themselves. Only an admin resets a Manager's PIN.
STAFF_PIN_ADMIN_RESET.fix: Ask an admin to reset the PIN in the Staff tab.

STAFF_PIN_RESET_NOT_REQUIRED.title: PIN does not need replacing
STAFF_PIN_RESET_NOT_REQUIRED.when: The signed-in person's PIN is not flagged for a reset.
STAFF_PIN_RESET_NOT_REQUIRED.fix: Nothing to do; keep using the current PIN.

STAFF_PIN_RESET_REQUIRED.title: New PIN needed
STAFF_PIN_RESET_REQUIRED.when: The signed-in person has a shared PIN and has not taken the new one the server sets.

STAFF_PIN_TAKEN.title: PIN in use
STAFF_PIN_TAKEN.when: Another active staff member has that PIN, so the person cannot be re-enabled with it.
STAFF_PIN_TAKEN.fix: Reset the PIN, then try again.

STAFF_REQUIRED.title: Staff sign-in required
STAFF_REQUIRED.when: The scanner has no signed-in staff member.
STAFF_REQUIRED.fix: Sign in with a staff PIN, then retry.

STAFF_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.title: Staff sign-in off
STAFF_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.when: Staff sign-in is not turned on for this scanner.
STAFF_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.fix: Turn on staff sign-in in the scanner's settings.

STAFF_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.title: Sign in first
STAFF_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.when: A new PIN was sent before any staff member signed in on this scanner.
STAFF_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.fix: Sign in with POST /scan/staff, then send the new PIN.

STAFF_SIGN_IN_UNAVAILABLE.title: Staff sign-in needs a paired scanner
STAFF_SIGN_IN_UNAVAILABLE.when: Staff sign-in works only on a paired scanner.
STAFF_SIGN_IN_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Pair the scanner, then sign in.

STALE.title: Out of date
STALE.when: The resource changed after you read it.
STALE.fix: Read it again and resend with the new version.

STAMPS_ABOVE_MAX.title: Stamps above the maximum
STAMPS_ABOVE_MAX.when: The card holds more stamps than the new version allows.
STAMPS_ABOVE_MAX.fix: Raise the template's stamp maximum, or redeem stamps first.

STAMPS_CARD_FULL.title: Stamp card full
STAMPS_CARD_FULL.when: The card is full and cannot take another stamp.
STAMPS_CARD_FULL.fix: Redeem the reward, then add stamps.

STAMPS_NONE.title: No stamps
STAMPS_NONE.when: The pass or template has no stamps.

STAMPS_NO_REWARD.title: No reward to redeem
STAMPS_NO_REWARD.when: The card is not full, so there is no reward.
STAMPS_NO_REWARD.fix: Add stamps until the card is full, then redeem.

STAMPS_QUERY.title: Stamp counts unreadable
STAMPS_QUERY.when: The stamp counts could not be read.

STAMPS_REDRAW.title: Stamp change needs the designer
STAMPS_REDRAW.when: A stamps change needs the card redrawn.
STAMPS_REDRAW.fix: Make the change in the template designer and publish a new version.

STEP_UP_REQUIRED.title: Confirm it's you
STEP_UP_REQUIRED.when: A sensitive action needs a Polaris ID sign-in from the last 10 minutes, and this session's sign-in is older. API keys never get it.
STEP_UP_REQUIRED.fix: Open signInUrl to sign in with Polaris ID again, then repeat the action.

TAGS_OFF.title: Tags off
TAGS_OFF.when: NFC tags are not turned on for the organization.
TAGS_OFF.fix: Turn on tags in the organization's settings.

TAG_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.title: Tag already assigned
TAG_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.when: The tag was assigned to another pass while yours ran.
TAG_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.fix: Fetch the tag and check its holder before reassigning.

TAG_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.title: Manager approval required
TAG_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.when: Binding this tag needs a manager's approval.
TAG_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.fix: Have a manager approve it with their PIN.

TAG_ASSIGN_FORBIDDEN.title: Tag assignment not allowed
TAG_ASSIGN_FORBIDDEN.when: Assigning tags is off on this scanner, or the staff role is too low.
TAG_ASSIGN_FORBIDDEN.fix: Turn on assigning in the scanner's settings, or sign in as Desk or above.

TAG_ASSURANCE_LOW.title: Secure tag required
TAG_ASSURANCE_LOW.when: The pass needs a tag with stronger security than this one.
TAG_ASSURANCE_LOW.fix: Assign a secure tag type to the pass.

TAG_CARD_AMBIGUOUS.title: Several passes match
TAG_CARD_AMBIGUOUS.when: The card matches more than one pass.
TAG_CARD_AMBIGUOUS.fix: Scan the card again, or assign the tag to a pass directly.

TAG_CHECK_FAILED.title: Tag check failed
TAG_CHECK_FAILED.when: The tag failed its authenticity check.

TAG_HOLDER_CHANGED.title: Tag holder changed
TAG_HOLDER_CHANGED.when: The tag's holder changed while your request ran.
TAG_HOLDER_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the tag and send the request again.

TAG_ID_INVALID.title: Tag ID not valid
TAG_ID_INVALID.when: The typed tag ID is not 4, 7 or 10 bytes in the chosen format.
TAG_ID_INVALID.fix: Check the ID against the reader or the supplier's list.

TAG_KEY_LIMITED.title: Key limited to templates
TAG_KEY_LIMITED.when: A key limited to templates assigned a typed tag ID or a user-scope tag, or listed tags that are not spare.
TAG_KEY_LIMITED.fix: Assign a spare tag to a pass with scope pass, or use a key without template limits.

TAG_KEY_UNREADABLE.title: Tag key unreadable
TAG_KEY_UNREADABLE.when: A stored tag key could not be decrypted.
TAG_KEY_UNREADABLE.fix: Retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

TAG_LENT.title: Tag is on loan
TAG_LENT.when: A holder tried to report a loaner tag lost. A loaner belongs to the desk.
TAG_LENT.fix: Hand the tag back at the desk.

TAG_LIMIT.title: Tag limit reached
TAG_LIMIT.when: The organization already has the most tags its plan allows.
TAG_LIMIT.fix: Release unused tags, or ask the platform owner to raise the limit.

TAG_NOT_ASSIGNED.title: Tag not assigned
TAG_NOT_ASSIGNED.when: The tag is not assigned to any pass.
TAG_NOT_ASSIGNED.fix: Assign the tag before this action.

TAG_NOT_FOUND.title: Tag not found
TAG_NOT_FOUND.when: No tag with this id exists in this mode and organization.

TAG_NOT_LENT.title: Tag is not lent
TAG_NOT_LENT.when: A lent tag was tapped to sign out or read a pass, but the tag is not on loan.
TAG_NOT_LENT.fix: Name the pass instead, or lend the tag first.

TAG_NO_ACCOUNT.title: Holder has no account
TAG_NO_ACCOUNT.when: The person has no account to bind the tag to yet.
TAG_NO_ACCOUNT.fix: Assign the tag to the pass instead.

TAG_PASS_EXPIRED.title: Pass has ended
TAG_PASS_EXPIRED.when: The pass's validity window has ended, so it takes no new tag.
TAG_PASS_EXPIRED.fix: Extend the pass's end date, or assign the tag to another pass.

TAG_PASS_NOT_ACCEPTED.title: Pass not accepted here
TAG_PASS_NOT_ACCEPTED.when: The scanner does not accept this pass.
TAG_PASS_NOT_ACCEPTED.fix: Add the pass's template or event to the scanner's session.

TAG_POOL_UNSUPPORTED.title: Loaner tags unavailable
TAG_POOL_UNSUPPORTED.when: Loaner tag pools are not available yet.
TAG_POOL_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Assign the tag to a pass or person instead.

TAG_REQUEST_BUSY.title: Tag request open
TAG_REQUEST_BUSY.when: A tag request is already open for this pass.
TAG_REQUEST_BUSY.fix: Cancel the open request or wait for it to finish.

TAG_REQUEST_EXPIRED.title: Tag request expired
TAG_REQUEST_EXPIRED.when: The tag request timed out before a scanner finished it.

TAG_SCANNER_ONLY.title: Tags assign on a scanner
TAG_SCANNER_ONLY.when: Tag assignment was attempted outside a scanner.
TAG_SCANNER_ONLY.fix: Assign the tag from a paired scanner.

TAG_SECURE_REQUIRED.title: Secure tags only
TAG_SECURE_REQUIRED.when: The session or tag type takes Secure tags and this one is Basic.
TAG_SECURE_REQUIRED.fix: Use a Secure (SUN) tag, or lower the session's tag level.

TAG_SUN_RATE_LIMITED.title: Tag reads limited
TAG_SUN_RATE_LIMITED.when: This device failed too many tag signature checks in the window.
TAG_SUN_RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait for Retry-After seconds, then scan again. Check the tag is one of the org’s own.

TAG_SUN_REPLAY.title: Tag read replayed
TAG_SUN_REPLAY.when: The tag's one-time read counter was already used, so the read looks copied.
TAG_SUN_REPLAY.fix: Tap the tag again for a fresh read.

TAG_SYSTEM_DISABLED.title: Tag system unavailable
TAG_SYSTEM_DISABLED.when: The tag system is not available for this organization.
TAG_SYSTEM_DISABLED.fix: Pick a tag system that is available, or contact the platform owner.

TAG_TYPED_OFF.title: Tag must be tapped
TAG_TYPED_OFF.when: The tag type doesn't allow a tag ID to be typed in.
TAG_TYPED_OFF.fix: Tap the tag on a scanner, or allow typed IDs on the tag type.

TAG_TYPE_ARCHIVED.title: Tag type archived
TAG_TYPE_ARCHIVED.when: The tag type is archived and cannot be used or changed.
TAG_TYPE_ARCHIVED.fix: Restore the tag type or use another.

TAG_TYPE_CHANGED.title: Tag type changed
TAG_TYPE_CHANGED.when: Another request changed this tag type while yours ran.
TAG_TYPE_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the tag type and send your change again.

TAG_TYPE_CHOOSE.title: Tag type needed
TAG_TYPE_CHOOSE.when: More than one tag type fits the pass and the org has no default.
TAG_TYPE_CHOOSE.fix: Send `typeId`, or set a default tag type for the organization.

TAG_TYPE_LIMIT.title: Pass has this tag type
TAG_TYPE_LIMIT.when: The pass already holds as many tags of this type as the type allows.
TAG_TYPE_LIMIT.fix: Remove the pass's current tag of this type first, or use another type.

TAG_TYPE_LOANER_SCOPE.title: Visitor tag type is pass-only
TAG_TYPE_LOANER_SCOPE.when: A tag type with use `visitor` was created or changed to a scope other than `pass`.

TAG_TYPE_MISMATCH.title: Tag type not allowed on this pass
TAG_TYPE_MISMATCH.when: The tag type is limited to other templates.
TAG_TYPE_MISMATCH.fix: Choose a tag type that lists this pass's template.

TAG_TYPE_NAME_TAKEN.title: Tag type name taken
TAG_TYPE_NAME_TAKEN.when: Another tag type in the organization has this name.

TAG_TYPE_NOT_FOUND.title: Tag type not found
TAG_TYPE_NOT_FOUND.when: No tag type with this id exists in this mode and organization.

TAG_TYPE_SCOPE.title: Tag type not allowed here
TAG_TYPE_SCOPE.when: The tag type doesn't allow this way of assigning, such as a person-wide tag.
TAG_TYPE_SCOPE.fix: Choose a tag type with the scope you need.

TAG_TYPE_SET.title: Tag already has a type
TAG_TYPE_SET.when: The request names a different type for a tag that has one.
TAG_TYPE_SET.fix: Leave `typeId` out, or change the tag's type in the console first.

TAG_TYPE_SYSTEM.title: Tag type is for another tag system
TAG_TYPE_SYSTEM.when: The tag type is for Basic tags and the tag is Secure, or the reverse.
TAG_TYPE_SYSTEM.fix: Choose a tag type for this tag's system.

TAG_UID_RANDOM.title: Tag randomizes its ID
TAG_UID_RANDOM.when: The tag changes its ID on each read, so it cannot be registered.
TAG_UID_RANDOM.fix: Use a tag with a fixed ID.

TAG_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.title: Undo on another scanner
TAG_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.when: Only the scanner that assigned the tag can undo it.
TAG_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.fix: Undo on that scanner, or have an admin remove the tag.

TAG_UNREADABLE.title: Tag unreadable
TAG_UNREADABLE.when: The scanner could not read the tag.
TAG_UNREADABLE.fix: Hold the tag steady, or use another tag.

TAG_USE_MISMATCH.title: Pass doesn't take this tag use
TAG_USE_MISMATCH.when: The pass's template doesn't accept tags for this use (member, staff or visitor).
TAG_USE_MISMATCH.fix: Choose a tag type whose use the template accepts.

TELL_ALREADY_SENT.title: Holders already told
TELL_ALREADY_SENT.when: Another member already sent the message that tells holders about this release.
TELL_ALREADY_SENT.fix: Nothing to do. Open Messages to see it.

TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED.title: Template archived
TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED.when: The template is archived and cannot be used here.
TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED.fix: Restore it with POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/restore, or use another template.

TEMPLATE_ASSET_CONFLICT.title: Template asset conflict
TEMPLATE_ASSET_CONFLICT.when: A template asset was missing or differed right after the version was created.

TEMPLATE_BAKED.title: Built-in template
TEMPLATE_BAKED.when: The template is built in and cannot be archived or reused by name.
TEMPLATE_BAKED.fix: Clone it with POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/clone and change the clone.

TEMPLATE_BLUEPRINT_INACTIVE.title: Template blueprint inactive
TEMPLATE_BLUEPRINT_INACTIVE.when: This blueprint is no longer offered.

TEMPLATE_CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND.title: Candidate not found
TEMPLATE_CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND.when: No release candidate with this id exists for the template.

TEMPLATE_CONFLICT.title: Template changed
TEMPLATE_CONFLICT.when: Another request changed the template while yours ran.
TEMPLATE_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/templates/{id} and send your change again.

TEMPLATE_CONTENT_CHANGED.title: Approved content changed
TEMPLATE_CONTENT_CHANGED.when: The template's approved content changed while the pass was being issued.
TEMPLATE_CONTENT_CHANGED.fix: Send the request again to use the current release.

TEMPLATE_EXISTS.title: Template exists
TEMPLATE_EXISTS.when: A template with this name exists.

TEMPLATE_IN_TAG_TYPE.title: Template in tag type
TEMPLATE_IN_TAG_TYPE.when: A tag type uses this template.
TEMPLATE_IN_TAG_TYPE.fix: Remove it from the type first.

TEMPLATE_IN_USE.title: Template in use
TEMPLATE_IN_USE.when: Scanning events or setups use this template.

TEMPLATE_IS_BLUEPRINT.title: Template is blueprint
TEMPLATE_IS_BLUEPRINT.fix: Use this blueprint to make one first.

TEMPLATE_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Template in another mode
TEMPLATE_MODE_MISMATCH.when: The template's mode differs from the key's or session's mode.
TEMPLATE_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Use a key of the template's mode.

TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.title: Template not found
TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.when: No template with this id exists in this mode and organization.
TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id with GET /api/v1/templates and the key's mode.

TEMPLATE_NOT_RELEASED.title: Template not released
TEMPLATE_NOT_RELEASED.when: The template has no approved release for scanning.

TEMPLATE_NOT_SHAREABLE.title: Template cannot be shared
TEMPLATE_NOT_SHAREABLE.when: Only an unassigned upload can be shared.
TEMPLATE_NOT_SHAREABLE.fix: Share an upload that no organization has taken.

TEMPLATE_NOT_TESTED.title: Template not tested
TEMPLATE_NOT_TESTED.when: This version has not been released in Test.

TEMPLATE_ORG_REQUIRED.title: Template belongs to another organization
TEMPLATE_ORG_REQUIRED.when: The release action needs the template to belong to an organization.
TEMPLATE_ORG_REQUIRED.fix: Assign the template to an organization, then retry.

TEMPLATE_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.title: Wallet provider not configured
TEMPLATE_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.when: The wallet provider is not set up for template releases.
TEMPLATE_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Configure the provider for the organization, or release for another provider.

TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CHANGED.title: Release changed
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CHANGED.when: The template release changed while the request ran.
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CHANGED.fix: Read the template again and resend.

TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CONFLICT.title: Release changed
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CONFLICT.when: The approved release changed while your request ran.
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CONFLICT.fix: Send the request again to use the current release.

TEMPLATE_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND.title: Release not found
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND.when: No release with this id exists for the template.

TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.title: Approved release required
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.when: The template has no approved release available in this mode.

TEMPLATE_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND.title: No review requested
TEMPLATE_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND.when: No review was requested for this version, or it was released already.
TEMPLATE_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND.fix: Ask the author to request review of this version, then review it again.

TEMPLATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.title: Review required
TEMPLATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.when: Another reviewer must approve this version before it is released in Live.
TEMPLATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.fix: Request review with request: true, or have another reviewer approve it.

TEMPLATE_REVIEW_SUPERSEDED.title: Review request replaced
TEMPLATE_REVIEW_SUPERSEDED.when: A newer version of the template has an open request, so this one was replaced.
TEMPLATE_REVIEW_SUPERSEDED.fix: Review the newer version listed in the message.

TEMPLATE_SELF_APPROVAL.title: Authors cannot approve
TEMPLATE_SELF_APPROVAL.when: The candidate's author tried to approve it.
TEMPLATE_SELF_APPROVAL.fix: Have a different member approve the candidate.

TEMPLATE_SLUG_CONFLICT.title: Template name created meanwhile
TEMPLATE_SLUG_CONFLICT.when: Another template took the same name while yours was created.
TEMPLATE_SLUG_CONFLICT.fix: Send the request again, or choose a different name.

TEMPLATE_USED_BY_OTHER_ORG.title: Template used by other org
TEMPLATE_USED_BY_OTHER_ORG.when: Passes of another organization use this template.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Template version changed
TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONFLICT.when: Another request published a version while yours ran.
TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch the template and publish again.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONTENT_CONFLICT.title: Built-in content changed
TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONTENT_CONFLICT.when: A built-in template's content changed during synchronization.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.title: Template version not found
TEMPLATE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.when: The template has no version with this number.

TERMINAL_NOT_FOUND.title: Terminal not found
TERMINAL_NOT_FOUND.when: The terminal named in the device header does not exist in this organization.
TERMINAL_NOT_FOUND.fix: Use a terminal id from the key's terminals.

TERMINAL_ONLY.title: Key acts as a terminal
TERMINAL_ONLY.when: A scan key can act only as one of its terminals.
TERMINAL_ONLY.fix: Name one of the key's terminals in the device header.

TERM_MANAGED.title: Term set by a connection
TERM_MANAGED.when: A connection sets this pass's start, so it cannot be renewed here.
TERM_MANAGED.fix: Change the term in the connected system.

TERM_NONE.title: Pass has no term
TERM_NONE.when: The pass's template has no term to renew.
TERM_NONE.fix: Renew only passes whose template defines a term.

TERM_NOT_STARTED.title: Term not started
TERM_NOT_STARTED.when: The pass's term has not started yet.

TEST_FORWARD_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED.title: Email already forwarded
TEST_FORWARD_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED.when: This captured email is being sent or has an unknown delivery outcome.
TEST_FORWARD_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED.fix: Do not send it again; check your inbox first.

TEST_FORWARD_CHANGED.title: Forward changed
TEST_FORWARD_CHANGED.when: The email or the account changed while sending.

TEST_FORWARD_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.title: Test forward outcome unknown
TEST_FORWARD_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.fix: Do not send this message again.

TEST_FORWARD_PREPARATION_FAILED.title: Test forward preparation failed
TEST_FORWARD_PREPARATION_FAILED.when: The test email could not be prepared.

TEST_KEY_REQUIRED.title: Test key required
TEST_KEY_REQUIRED.when: Reading the test inbox needs a test-mode key.
TEST_KEY_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key that starts with pb_test_.

TOKEN_SEAL_MISMATCH.title: Token not found
TOKEN_SEAL_MISMATCH.when: The token does not match what this pass was sealed with.
TOKEN_SEAL_MISMATCH.fix: Use the link or code from the pass itself.

UNAUTHENTICATED.title: No credentials
UNAUTHENTICATED.when: The request has no valid credentials.

UNDO_SUPERSEDED.title: Undo superseded
UNDO_SUPERSEDED.when: A later scan replaced this one.

UNDO_UNCONFIRMED.title: Undo not confirmed
UNDO_UNCONFIRMED.when: The server could not confirm that the undo was written.
UNDO_UNCONFIRMED.fix: Check the scan's state, then retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE.title: Unknown template
UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE.when: A template id does not exist or belongs to another organization.

UNLOCK_REQUIRED.title: Staff PIN required
UNLOCK_REQUIRED.when: Switching back from this role needs a staff PIN.

UNSAFE_URL.title: URL not allowed
UNSAFE_URL.when: The URL is invalid, not https, or points to a blocked host.

UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND.title: Upload not found
UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND.when: No template upload with this id exists in this mode and organization.

UPSTREAM.title: Upstream failed
UPSTREAM.when: A service PassBook depends on refused or failed the request.
UPSTREAM.fix: Send the request again after the Retry-After delay.

USER_NOT_FOUND.title: User not found
USER_NOT_FOUND.when: No user with this id exists.

VALIDATION.title: Validation failed
VALIDATION.when: A body, query or path value breaks the schema.
VALIDATION.fix: Fix each field in issues and resend.

VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Stale version
VERSION_CONFLICT.when: If-Match holds an older version than the pass has.
VERSION_CONFLICT.fix: GET the pass, apply your change to it, and resend with the new version.

VERSION_INVALID.title: Template version invalid
VERSION_INVALID.when: The version cannot be released or compared.
VERSION_INVALID.fix: Use a version number from GET /api/v1/templates/{id}.

VERSION_NOT_FOUND.title: Version not found
VERSION_NOT_FOUND.when: The pass has no version with this number.

VERSION_PURGED.title: Version purged
VERSION_PURGED.when: This pass version is no longer stored.

WALLET_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT.title: Wallet account changed
WALLET_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT.when: The wallet credential or enrolment changed while your request ran.
WALLET_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it again and send your change.

WALLET_ACCOUNT_INSTANCES_ACTIVE.title: Wallet account still in use
WALLET_ACCOUNT_INSTANCES_ACTIVE.when: Provider instances are still active under this account.
WALLET_ACCOUNT_INSTANCES_ACTIVE.fix: Retire all provider instances, then revoke the account.

WALLET_ACCOUNT_MOVED.title: Wallet account moved
WALLET_ACCOUNT_MOVED.when: The wallet account was moved and this id no longer applies.
WALLET_ACCOUNT_MOVED.fix: List accounts with GET /api/v1/wallet-providers/accounts and use the current one.

WALLET_ART_MISMATCH.title: Wallet art cannot be resized
WALLET_ART_MISMATCH.when: An image cannot be cut to the size the wallet provider needs.
WALLET_ART_MISMATCH.fix: Replace the image with one at the size shown in issues.

WALLET_CREDENTIALS_INVALID.title: Wallet credentials invalid
WALLET_CREDENTIALS_INVALID.fix: Fix the credentials named in issues and send them again.

WALLET_CREDENTIALS_UNAVAILABLE.title: Wallet credentials unavailable
WALLET_CREDENTIALS_UNAVAILABLE.when: The stored provider credentials could not be loaded.

WALLET_ENROLMENT_HELD.title: Enrolment held by platform
WALLET_ENROLMENT_HELD.when: The platform owner holds this enrolment, so it cannot change.
WALLET_ENROLMENT_HELD.fix: Ask the platform owner to release the hold.

WALLET_ENROLMENT_PREREQUISITE.title: Enrolment steps missing
WALLET_ENROLMENT_PREREQUISITE.when: The enrolment needs earlier steps finished first.
WALLET_ENROLMENT_PREREQUISITE.fix: Finish the steps listed in the response, then retry.

WALLET_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE.title: Provider identity cannot change
WALLET_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE.when: The issuer or identity of a wallet account cannot be edited.
WALLET_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE.fix: Create a new account for the new identity.

WALLET_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.title: Wallet image not found
WALLET_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.when: No stored wallet image matches this hash.
WALLET_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Rebuild the wallet projection and use the new image URL.

WALLET_ISSUER_EXISTS.title: Issuer exists
WALLET_ISSUER_EXISTS.when: Google already has an issuer for this account.
WALLET_ISSUER_EXISTS.fix: Attach it as a shared issuer instead.

WALLET_ISSUER_NOT_WAITING.title: Issuer not waiting
WALLET_ISSUER_NOT_WAITING.when: The issuer is not waiting for Google approval.
WALLET_ISSUER_NOT_WAITING.fix: Check the issuer status before completing it.

WALLET_KEY_HELD.title: Key still in use
WALLET_KEY_HELD.when: A credential still holds the key being retired.
WALLET_KEY_HELD.fix: Move the credential to the new key, then send the request again.

WALLET_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Wallet mode mismatch
WALLET_MODE_MISMATCH.when: The requested mode differs from the key's mode.
WALLET_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Use a key of the same mode as the request.

WALLET_OFFER_NOT_FOUND.title: Wallet offer not found
WALLET_OFFER_NOT_FOUND.when: The wallet offer link is not valid anymore.
WALLET_OFFER_NOT_FOUND.fix: Request a new offer for the pass.

WALLET_PLATFORM_CREDENTIAL_MISSING.title: Platform credential missing
WALLET_PLATFORM_CREDENTIAL_MISSING.when: The platform has no Google credential configured.
WALLET_PLATFORM_CREDENTIAL_MISSING.fix: Ask the platform owner to add it, then send the request again.

WALLET_PROJECTION_BLOCKED.title: Wallet projection blocked
WALLET_PROJECTION_BLOCKED.when: The template cannot be projected to the provider as it stands.
WALLET_PROJECTION_BLOCKED.fix: Fix the problems the response lists and build the projection again.

WALLET_PROJECTION_CONFLICT.title: Wallet projection changed
WALLET_PROJECTION_CONFLICT.when: The projection, source release or provider account changed while your request ran.
WALLET_PROJECTION_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch the candidate again and send your request.

WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA_RETIRED.title: Field mappings retired
WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA_RETIRED.when: A Samsung candidate carried a hand-mapped (schema 1) projection.
WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA_RETIRED.fix: Send a compiled projection: schema 2 with the omissions the report lists.

WALLET_PROJECTION_NOT_FOUND.title: Wallet projection not found
WALLET_PROJECTION_NOT_FOUND.when: No projection candidate with this id exists.
WALLET_PROJECTION_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id and create a candidate if it expired.

WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA.title: Projection format outdated
WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA.when: The candidate uses an older wallet format than the Google release needs.
WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA.fix: Create a new candidate from the current release.

WALLET_PROJECTION_UNSUPPORTED.title: Template not supported by the provider
WALLET_PROJECTION_UNSUPPORTED.when: The template uses wallet features the provider's native format cannot show.
WALLET_PROJECTION_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Remove the unsupported features or release without this provider.

WALLET_RUN_BUSY.title: Run busy
WALLET_RUN_BUSY.fix: Send the request again in a minute.

WEBHOOK_ALREADY_FINISHED.title: Webhook work finished
WEBHOOK_ALREADY_FINISHED.when: The webhook item has already finished.
WEBHOOK_ALREADY_FINISHED.fix: Do nothing; check its status with GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/webhook-failures.

WEBHOOK_CAPTURE_NOT_FOUND.title: Capture not found
WEBHOOK_CAPTURE_NOT_FOUND.when: No capture with this id exists on this endpoint; it may be older than 7 days or past the last 200.
WEBHOOK_CAPTURE_NOT_FOUND.fix: List the endpoint's captures with GET /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/captures.

WEBHOOK_CONTEXT_CONFLICT.title: Webhook context changed
WEBHOOK_CONTEXT_CONFLICT.when: The connection changed after the webhook arrived.
WEBHOOK_CONTEXT_CONFLICT.fix: Resend the event from the source system.

WEBHOOK_DISPATCH_INCOMPLETE.title: Webhook dispatch incomplete
WEBHOOK_DISPATCH_INCOMPLETE.when: Not every retained webhook item was queued.

WEBHOOK_EFFECT_UNCERTAIN.title: Webhook outcome uncertain
WEBHOOK_EFFECT_UNCERTAIN.when: A webhook item may still be running or its outcome is unknown.
WEBHOOK_EFFECT_UNCERTAIN.fix: Resolve it with POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/webhook-failures/{retentionId}/resolve after checking the pass.

WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.title: Webhook endpoint not found
WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.when: No endpoint with this id exists in this mode and organization.

WEBHOOK_ENQUEUE_FAILED.title: Webhook not queued
WEBHOOK_ENQUEUE_FAILED.when: The webhook could not be queued for processing.

WEBHOOK_ITEM_BUSY.title: Webhook item busy
WEBHOOK_ITEM_BUSY.when: The webhook item is already running.

WEBHOOK_ITEM_PENDING.title: Webhook item pending
WEBHOOK_ITEM_PENDING.when: The webhook item has not finished processing.

WEBHOOK_NOTHING_TO_RESOLVE.title: Nothing to resolve
WEBHOOK_NOTHING_TO_RESOLVE.when: The connection has no uncertain webhook items.
WEBHOOK_NOTHING_TO_RESOLVE.fix: Do nothing; list failures with GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/webhook-failures.

WEBHOOK_NOT_FOUND.title: Webhook work not found
WEBHOOK_NOT_FOUND.when: No webhook item with this id exists for the connection.

WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD.title: Webhook body invalid
WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD.when: The incoming webhook body is not valid for this connector.
WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD.fix: Send the body in the format the connector documents.

WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_MISSING.title: Webhook payload missing
WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_MISSING.when: The stored webhook payload is not available.
WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_MISSING.fix: Retry with backoff; if it persists, resend the event from the source.

WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE.title: Webhook configuration unavailable
WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE.when: The connection's webhook configuration could not be read.

WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE_CHANGED.title: Webhook mode changed
WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE_CHANGED.when: The connector's reference mode changed after the webhook arrived.
WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE_CHANGED.fix: Resend the event from the source system.

WEBHOOK_RESOLVE_CONFLICT.title: Webhook changed
WEBHOOK_RESOLVE_CONFLICT.when: The webhook item changed while you resolved it.
WEBHOOK_RESOLVE_CONFLICT.fix: List failures again and resolve once more.

WEBHOOK_RETENTION_FAILED.title: Webhook not retained
WEBHOOK_RETENTION_FAILED.when: The webhook could not be stored for processing.

WEBHOOK_RETENTION_UNAVAILABLE.title: Webhook retention unavailable
WEBHOOK_RETENTION_UNAVAILABLE.when: The store for retained webhooks is unavailable.

WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE.title: Webhook signature invalid
WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE.when: The webhook signature does not match the connection's secret.
WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE.fix: Sign the body with the connection's current webhook secret.

WEBHOOK_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.title: Original webhook context gone
WEBHOOK_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.when: The context the webhook ran under is no longer stored.
WEBHOOK_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Resend the event from the source system instead of replaying.

WEBHOOK_STALE_CONTEXT.title: Webhook context stale
WEBHOOK_STALE_CONTEXT.when: The connection changed after the webhook arrived.
WEBHOOK_STALE_CONTEXT.fix: Resend the event from the source system.

WEBHOOK_STILL_PENDING.title: Webhook still queued
WEBHOOK_STILL_PENDING.when: The webhook item is still waiting to run.
WEBHOOK_STILL_PENDING.fix: Wait for it to run before resolving it.

WEBHOOK_UNAVAILABLE.title: Webhook not accepted
WEBHOOK_UNAVAILABLE.when: The webhook could not be accepted or started right now.

WEBHOOK_WORK_CHANGED.title: Webhook work changed
WEBHOOK_WORK_CHANGED.when: The webhook work changed while it was handled.

WORKFLOW_START.title: Job did not start
WORKFLOW_START.when: The background job did not start.

ZONE_ARCHIVED.title: Zone archived
ZONE_ARCHIVED.fix: Use a zone that is not archived.

ZONE_CYCLE.title: Zone inside itself
ZONE_CYCLE.when: The new parent is inside the zone's own subtree.
ZONE_CYCLE.fix: Choose a parent outside the zone.

ZONE_DEPTH.title: Zones nested too deep
ZONE_DEPTH.when: Zones nest three levels deep at most.
ZONE_DEPTH.fix: Move the zone higher in the tree.

ZONE_EVENT_SESSION.title: Event sessions take no zones
ZONE_EVENT_SESSION.when: The session tracks an event, not zones.
ZONE_EVENT_SESSION.fix: Use a zone session, or remove the zones.

ZONE_KEY_TAKEN.title: Zone key taken
ZONE_KEY_TAKEN.when: Another zone already uses this key.

ZONE_NAME_TAKEN.title: Zone name taken
ZONE_NAME_TAKEN.when: Another zone already has this name.

ZONE_NOT_FOUND.title: Zone not found
ZONE_NOT_FOUND.when: No zone with this id exists in this mode and organization.

MATCH_AMBIGUOUS_FIELD.title: Input has different types
MATCH_AMBIGUOUS_FIELD.when: A match without a template names an input that your templates give different types.

MATCH_TOO_BROAD.title: Too many passes match
MATCH_TOO_BROAD.when: A selection by filter or import matches more than 20,000 passes. Change runs check this when previewed and when made.
MATCH_TOO_BROAD.fix: Narrow the filter and send the request again.

SELECTION_USE_RUN.title: Use a bulk run
SELECTION_USE_RUN.when: POST /passes/bulk was given a filter that matches more than 100 passes.
SELECTION_USE_RUN.fix: Send the same selection to POST /passes/bulk-runs.

BULK_RUN_ENDED.title: The run has ended
BULK_RUN_ENDED.when: The bulk run is done, stopped or failed.
BULK_RUN_ENDED.fix: Start a new run if passes are left.

BULK_RUN_NOT_FOUND.title: Run not found
BULK_RUN_NOT_FOUND.when: No bulk run with this id exists in this organization and mode.
BULK_RUN_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, organization and mode.

BULK_RUN_START.title: The run did not start
BULK_RUN_START.when: The background run could not be created.

VIEWS_CHANGED.title: Views changed
VIEWS_CHANGED.when: The saved views changed since the revision you sent.
VIEWS_CHANGED.fix: Read the views again and save with the new revision.

PASS_CHANGED.title: Pass changed
PASS_CHANGED.when: A pass moved since the bulk run's snapshot; the run skips it and counts it under PASS_CHANGED.
PASS_CHANGED.fix: Start a new run for the passes that are left.

SANDBOX_CLOSED.title: Sandbox is closed
SANDBOX_CLOSED.when: You asked to reset a closed developer sandbox.
SANDBOX_CLOSED.fix: Reopen the sandbox first, then reset it.

SANDBOX_NOT_CLOSED.title: Sandbox is already open
SANDBOX_NOT_CLOSED.when: You asked to reopen a sandbox that is open.
SANDBOX_NOT_CLOSED.fix: Nothing to do: the sandbox is open.

SANDBOX_REOPEN_ADMIN.title: An administrator closed this sandbox
SANDBOX_REOPEN_ADMIN.when: Only the person or the idle sweep can reopen a sandbox they closed; an administrator's close stays closed.
SANDBOX_REOPEN_ADMIN.fix: Ask an administrator to reopen it.

SANDBOX_REOPEN_WINDOW.title: The reopen window has passed
SANDBOX_REOPEN_WINDOW.when: A closed sandbox can be reopened for 30 days.
SANDBOX_REOPEN_WINDOW.fix: The sandbox cannot be reopened; it is not made again, as there is one per person.

SANDBOX_RESET_LIMIT.title: Too many resets today
SANDBOX_RESET_LIMIT.when: A sandbox can be reset 3 times in a day.
SANDBOX_RESET_LIMIT.fix: Wait until the oldest reset of the day is 24 hours old, then reset again.

FILE_STATE.title: File not in that state
FILE_STATE.when: The revision is not pending, or another upload landed first.

FILE_EXPIRED.title: Upload expired
FILE_EXPIRED.when: A draft or pending revision is older than 23 hours.

FILE_NOT_FOUND.title: File not found
FILE_NOT_FOUND.when: No draft upload with this id exists in the organization.

FILE_ID_COLUMN_MISSING.title: ID column missing
FILE_ID_COLUMN_MISSING.when: The file has no such column, or no row has a value in it.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.title: File too large
FILE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Split the file or remove columns.

FILE_BAD_POINTER.title: Records path invalid
FILE_BAD_POINTER.when: recordsPointer is not a JSON pointer into the file.
FILE_BAD_POINTER.fix: Use a path that starts with /.

FILE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND.title: Sheet not found
FILE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND.when: The workbook has no sheet with this name.

FILE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.title: File type not supported
FILE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.when: The file is not CSV, Excel (.xlsx) or JSON.

FILE_MACRO.title: Macros not allowed
FILE_MACRO.fix: Save it as a plain .xlsx or CSV.

FILE_EMPTY.title: File is empty
FILE_EMPTY.when: The file has no data rows.

FILE_DAMAGED.title: File could not be read
FILE_DAMAGED.when: The file is damaged or not valid.

FILE_ARCHIVE_LIMIT.title: Workbook too large
FILE_ARCHIVE_LIMIT.when: The workbook inflates past its limits.

FILE_XML_UNSAFE.title: Workbook not accepted
FILE_XML_UNSAFE.when: The workbook holds markup the platform refuses.

FILE_TOO_MANY_ROWS.title: Too many rows
FILE_TOO_MANY_ROWS.when: The file has more than 10,000 rows.

FILE_TOO_MANY_COLUMNS.title: Too many columns
FILE_TOO_MANY_COLUMNS.when: The file has more than 100 columns.

FILE_TOO_MANY_CELLS.title: Too many cells
FILE_TOO_MANY_CELLS.when: The workbook has more cells than the limit.

FILE_CELL_TOO_LONG.title: Value too long
FILE_CELL_TOO_LONG.when: A value has more than 2,000 characters.

FILE_LINE_TOO_LONG.title: Line too long
FILE_LINE_TOO_LONG.when: A line is longer than 64 KB.

FILE_HEADER_TOO_LONG.title: Header too long
FILE_HEADER_TOO_LONG.when: A header has more than 200 characters.

FILE_ROW_SHAPE.title: Row has too many cells
FILE_ROW_SHAPE.when: A row has more cells than the header.
FILE_ROW_SHAPE.fix: Fix the row and upload again.

FILE_JSON_TOO_DEEP.title: JSON nested too deep
FILE_JSON_TOO_DEEP.when: The JSON is nested more than 32 levels.

FILE_NOT_RECORDS.title: Not a list of records
FILE_NOT_RECORDS.when: The file, or the records path, is not a list of objects.

FILE_RECORDS_NOT_FOUND.title: Records path not found
FILE_RECORDS_NOT_FOUND.when: recordsPointer points at nothing in the file.

DEVELOPER_INVITE_PENDING.title: Developer invitation already pending
DEVELOPER_INVITE_PENDING.when: The address already has a pending developer invitation in this organization.
DEVELOPER_INVITE_PENDING.fix: Revoke the pending invitation, then invite again.

DEVELOPER_INVITE_CONFLICT.title: Developer invitation changed
DEVELOPER_INVITE_CONFLICT.when: The invitation was already revoked or accepted.
DEVELOPER_INVITE_CONFLICT.fix: List the invitations and check its state.

IDP_BUDGET.title: Too many Polaris ID setups today
IDP_BUDGET.when: The platform used its daily allowance of Polaris ID changes.

IDP_REFUSED.title: Polaris ID refused the change
IDP_REFUSED.when: The account is an administrator, is disabled or is not one PassBook may change in Polaris ID. Answers 409 when a role or adopted group is deleted, or an account cannot be added to a group here; 403 when Polaris ID itself refuses.

IDP_CLIENT.title: Polaris ID app needs a change
IDP_CLIENT.when: PassBook's app in Polaris ID is missing, is not PassBook's, has callbacks that are not PassBook's, is still open to everyone, or would lock admins out of PassBook if restricted.
IDP_CLIENT.fix: Open setup and follow the reason it shows, or ask the PassBook owner.

IDP_SCIM_FOREIGN.title: User sync points elsewhere
IDP_SCIM_FOREIGN.when: The owner pointed Polaris ID's user sync at a different address, so PassBook will not change or push to it.
IDP_SCIM_FOREIGN.fix: Ask the PassBook owner to point it back at PassBook.

IDP_SCIM_MISSING.title: User sync not set up
IDP_SCIM_MISSING.when: Polaris ID has no user sync connection for PassBook yet, so there is nothing to push or sync.
IDP_SCIM_MISSING.fix: Run setup to create the connection, then try again.

IDP_IN_USE.title: Group still in use
IDP_IN_USE.when: The Polaris ID group still has members or apps, so it cannot be deleted.
IDP_IN_USE.fix: Remove its members and apps, then delete it.

IDP_NOT_MANAGED.title: Account not managed by PassBook
IDP_NOT_MANAGED.when: PassBook did not create this Polaris ID account, so it cannot change it.

IDP_CONFLICT.title: Polaris ID changed
IDP_CONFLICT.when: The Polaris ID account or group changed while the request ran.

DEVELOPER_INVITE_ROLE_NEEDS_SESSION.title: Admin roles need the console
DEVELOPER_INVITE_ROLE_NEEDS_SESSION.when: A key invited a developer with, or removed one who holds, an org or integration admin role.
DEVELOPER_INVITE_ROLE_NEEDS_SESSION.fix: Do it from the console with a recent sign-in.

IDP_DRY_RUN.title: Polaris ID changes are in dry run
IDP_DRY_RUN.when: The binding to Polaris ID only records what it would change, so a platform invitation cannot be created or sent.
IDP_DRY_RUN.fix: Ask the owner to turn dry run off, then try again.

INVITATION_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED.title: Email not confirmed
INVITATION_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED.when: The Polaris ID made from the invitation has not confirmed the invited address.
INVITATION_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED.fix: Confirm the email in Polaris ID, then try again.

INVITATION_NOT_STARTED.title: No Polaris ID made yet
INVITATION_NOT_STARTED.when: Nobody has finished creating a Polaris ID from this invitation's link.
INVITATION_NOT_STARTED.fix: Create the Polaris ID from the invitation page, then confirm.

PLATFORM_INVITE_CONFLICT.title: Invitation has ended
PLATFORM_INVITE_CONFLICT.when: The platform invitation was accepted or revoked already.
PLATFORM_INVITE_CONFLICT.fix: Send a new invitation if the person still needs access.

PLATFORM_INVITE_PENDING.title: Invitation already pending
PLATFORM_INVITE_PENDING.when: This address already has an open platform invitation.
PLATFORM_INVITE_PENDING.fix: Revoke it or use Resend, then invite again.

REQUEST_LOG_NOT_FOUND.title: Request not found
REQUEST_LOG_NOT_FOUND.when: The log id or request id is not one of this organization's Test calls from the last 7 days.
REQUEST_LOG_NOT_FOUND.fix: List the calls with GET /request-logs and use an id from the list. Calls older than 7 days are gone.

SANDBOX_ENDPOINT_LIMIT.title: Sandbox endpoint limit
SANDBOX_ENDPOINT_LIMIT.when: The sandbox already holds 3 webhook endpoints, the capture endpoint included.
SANDBOX_ENDPOINT_LIMIT.fix: Delete one with DELETE /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}, then retry.

SANDBOX_TEST_ONLY.title: Sandbox is Test only
SANDBOX_TEST_ONLY.when: A request asked for Live in a developer sandbox, which never holds Live: a session or key that sent X-PassBook-Mode: live.
SANDBOX_TEST_ONLY.fix: Send the request in Test mode, or use an organization with Live access.

WORKBENCH_TEST_ONLY.title: Workbench is Test only
WORKBENCH_TEST_ONLY.when: A Workbench token asked for Live (a mode header, Live in modes, a Live key), or called an operation not marked x-workbench: test.
WORKBENCH_TEST_ONLY.fix: Stay in Test, or do it in admin or from your server with a key.

SIMULATE_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.title: Simulated device not found
SIMULATE_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.when: The deviceId is not a simulated device of this pass.
SIMULATE_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Use the deviceId returned by an installed event, or omit it for the newest device.

SIMULATE_NO_DEVICE.title: No simulated device
SIMULATE_NO_DEVICE.when: The event needs an installed simulated device and the pass has none, or the device is already removed.

SIMULATE_NO_EMAIL.title: No Test email
SIMULATE_NO_EMAIL.when: The Test inbox holds no message for this pass.
SIMULATE_NO_EMAIL.fix: Send the pass by email first, then simulate email_failed.

SIMULATE_RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many simulated events
SIMULATE_RATE_LIMITED.when: The organization sent more than 60 simulated events in a minute.
SIMULATE_RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait for the Retry-After seconds, then retry.

SIMULATE_TEST_ONLY.title: Simulate is Test only
SIMULATE_TEST_ONLY.when: The pass is a Live pass.

KEY_CANNOT_ADMINISTER.title: Key cannot administer
KEY_CANNOT_ADMINISTER.when: An API key tried to give, change or remove an organization admin role.
KEY_CANNOT_ADMINISTER.fix: Give or remove admin roles in the console.

WALLET_RELEASE_READY_CHANGED.title: Ready list changed
WALLET_RELEASE_READY_CHANGED.when: The ready enrollments changed since the dry run, or an earlier apply committed part of them.
WALLET_RELEASE_READY_CHANGED.fix: Run the dry run again: it lists what is still Off. Then apply those orgs.

API_KEY_PLATFORM_LIVE.title: Platform key is Live only
API_KEY_PLATFORM_LIVE.when: A platform key was requested in Test mode.
API_KEY_PLATFORM_LIVE.fix: Make the platform key in Live mode.

API_KEY_PLATFORM_SCOPES_ALONE.title: Platform and organization scopes mixed
API_KEY_PLATFORM_SCOPES_ALONE.when: A key was asked to hold platform scopes and organization scopes together.
API_KEY_PLATFORM_SCOPES_ALONE.fix: Make two keys: one with platform scopes, one with organization scopes.

API_KEY_PLATFORM_SCOPE_KIND.title: Platform scope on another kind of key
API_KEY_PLATFORM_SCOPE_KIND.when: A platform scope was requested for a key that is not a platform key.
API_KEY_PLATFORM_SCOPE_KIND.fix: Make a platform key (no organization) for platform scopes, or drop the platform scopes.

PERSON_REQUIRED.title: A person is required
PERSON_REQUIRED.when: An API key called a platform route, or made a request, that only a person signed in with Polaris ID may make.
PERSON_REQUIRED.fix: Do it in the console as a platform admin signed in with Polaris ID.

PLATFORM_KEY_REQUIRED.title: Platform key required
PLATFORM_KEY_REQUIRED.when: A platform route was called with an API key that is not a platform key.
PLATFORM_KEY_REQUIRED.fix: Call it with a platform key that holds the route's scope.

IDP_GROUP_LIMIT.title: Group limit reached
IDP_GROUP_LIMIT.when: PassBook manages at most 50 custom groups.
IDP_GROUP_LIMIT.fix: Delete a group you no longer use.

IDP_RULE_EXISTS.title: Rule exists
IDP_RULE_EXISTS.when: The org already has a rule on the group.
IDP_RULE_EXISTS.fix: End the existing rule, or leave it.

IDP_RULE_LIMIT.title: Rule limit reached
IDP_RULE_LIMIT.when: A group takes at most 5 org rules.
IDP_RULE_LIMIT.fix: End a rule you no longer need.

IDP_RULE_ORG_REFUSED.title: Org cannot feed a group
IDP_RULE_ORG_REFUSED.when: A personal org, sandbox or closed org cannot feed a group.

GROUP_NOT_FOUND.title: Group not found
GROUP_NOT_FOUND.when: No live group has this key.
GROUP_NOT_FOUND.fix: List the groups and use one of their keys.

IDP_MEMBER_EXISTS.title: Already a member
IDP_MEMBER_EXISTS.when: The account is already a member of the group.

IDP_MULTIPLE_ACCOUNTS.title: Several Polaris ID accounts
IDP_MULTIPLE_ACCOUNTS.when: The user has more than one Polaris ID account.
IDP_MULTIPLE_ACCOUNTS.fix: Remove the extra account in Polaris ID, then retry.

IDP_NO_ACCOUNT.title: No Polaris ID account
IDP_NO_ACCOUNT.when: The user is not in Polaris ID.
IDP_NO_ACCOUNT.fix: Invite the user to Polaris ID first.

MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.title: Member not found
MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.when: No live member has this id on the group.
MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.fix: List the group's members and use one of their ids.

IDP_PLATFORM_ADMIN.title: Platform admin
IDP_PLATFORM_ADMIN.when: The user is a platform admin. A key never changes a platform admin.

SELF_DISABLE.title: Cannot disable yourself
SELF_DISABLE.when: The account making the request is the one being disabled.
